ONE client per deployment (cluster preset or one self-registration). No https address and no relay ⇒ «连接需要 https 地址：开启 Tailscale HTTPS，或直接粘贴 Dropline key». A pasted key outranks OAuth.
- **The doors (lane dropline-connect-door, 2.369.298 — a fleet user could not find the sign-in)**: with no key and no sign-in the Plugins row's chip IS the door — 「Connect with Fish Audio」 (primary tone; title: or paste a Dropline key in Services › Integrations), opening the sheet; the sheet's Connect is followed by ONE line that opens Integrations focused on the Dropline card. That card signs in too: the registry row's `connect` block (src/lib/oauth-connect-row.js, the same block as the sheet) above an OPTIONAL key («Either sign in above, or paste a key»); its Test with no key tests the sign-in. Connect never waits for the switch (connect first, switch on after). Without https the block says who can fix it — `connectWhy` in /api/voice/status: `self-hosted` ⇒ Tailscale HTTPS or a key; `operator` (VIBESPACE_PUBLIC_URL set but http, or a cluster pod without an address) ⇒ ask the person who runs it to set VIBESPACE_PUBLIC_URL, or a key.
- **Teaching Dropline (P1) — the owner's rulings verbatim (2026-10-12):** `/v1/terms`、`/v1/context` 永不自动写；开着时只提议、用户逐批确认（卡片「加入词库 / 忽略」），显式第三档「本项目的文件名/标识符自动加入」按项目 opt-in；`/v1/context` 单独开关 + 首次预览 + journal。读 `/v1/vocabulary` 不需确认。 As built: the «教 Dropline» switch (default off, the sentence «会把当前对话里的名字、术语与文件名发给 Dropline（Fish Audio）——只发你确认的。凭据、附件、别的对话不发。») ⇒ after a dictation at most one proposal per conversation an hour (identifiers, file names, the Task Group name, minus the dictionary) as a card + a For-you item; only 加入词库 sends exactly the ticked words, 忽略 hides them 30 days; «这个项目的文件名与标识符自动加入，不再问» per working directory (revocable in the card's project list; ≤ 50/h, journaled) — named by SOURCE, never by shape (voice-verify F2, PURE `autoSourcesOf`): that project's files, paths an AGENT message names, identifiers in an AGENT message's code spans (`…` / fenced); a word from the person's own sentences always goes to the card; the context switch (default off) shows the exact text first (发送 / 不发), later sends ≤ 1/10 min when the text changed; caps terms 6/h, context 6/h; the journal + «在 dropline.fish.audio/app 查看或清除记忆».
- **The proposal = words a person SAYS** (lane voice-teach-candidates, 2026-10-13; userW saw a card of ~70 ticked API field names): PURE `proposalCandidates` (src/voice-model.js) reads only the person's sentences + the agent's prose (code spans / fences / URLs cut), drops the `SHAPE_EXCLUSIONS` census (id-prefix, placeholder, field-tail, two-underscores, digit-tail, short-caps, host, secret, code-only = snake/camel the person never wrote), needs weight ≥ 2 (the person's words count double), ranks shape (known-extension file, PascalCase) ≫ weight > pronounceable; `TEACH_LIMITS.proposePerCard` = 12, the words under the line wait in `teach.held` until seen more often; `pick` = the person wrote it or a file / PascalCase name seen ≥ 2. The card: chips (aria-pressed), 加入所选 (n) (disabled at 0), 忽略这批; the For-you item lists and adds `pick` only (none ⇒ no item). `termsOf` stays the per-project tier's input, unchanged. **Corrected (lane voice-teach-ids-allowed, owner 2026-10-13: ids are what dictation gets wrong most):** identifier NAMES are candidates again — inline `code` spans count as prose (fences / URLs still cut), `SHAPE_EXCLUSIONS` is four rows (secret = a scrubSecrets hit or a ≥ 16 vowel-less key run; placeholder = `xxx` / `<id>`; vendor-id = `cli_`/`ou_`/`oc_`/`om_`… + a digit run or ≥ 8 characters, so `om_id` stays; url-email-digits = URL, host, e-mail, digit-only), `pick` = the person wrote it or a file / PascalCase name / identifier seen ≥ 2; the card's why line names identifiers.
- **The suggestion is «not now», never a nag (lane voice-dictionary-nag, 2.369.334 — a fleet user 2026-10-21: 「一天到晚有这个 Dropline 让我发信息的消息, 站在我的 inbox 里」, 20 suggestions in 8 days, «CLAUDE.md» 7× re-offered from the same old messages; the user: no blacklist, no timers)**: the proposals' preselected words wait in ONE For-you item at a time — a later conversation's batch merges into it in place (the same id; the tray patches its keyed row) — filed `low`, so it waits in band 5 (no pin under urgent, no badge, no toast). ✕ / 忽略 / 「全部标为已看」 = «not now»: PURE voice-model's EVIDENCE LEDGER (per instance, data/voice-suggestions.json 0600, ≤ 2 000 words, the least recently touched out) CONSUMES the occurrences the word was shown on — the same messages never re-offer it; a NEW dictation that says it does (ONE swappable rule, `evidenceRule`). A new item waits 24 h after a dismissal (the card still lands on the sheet); 加入 sends exactly the item's words and they count as known at once. All Settings › Voice input › 「词典建议」 (`plugin.voice-input.suggest`, default ON; off ⇒ nothing is proposed) lists every word suggested now with 「加入词库」 / 「忽略」 (POST /api/voice/teach/word); 「词典建议放在哪里」 (`voice.suggestions.mode`: `item` default | `settings-only` ⇒ never a For-you item, the list only).
- **An ask only for an act that can succeed; «automatic» = no asking in that folder (lane voice-teach-skips, 2.369.343 — the owner 2026-10-22: «最近几次 dropline 添加都是跳过，如果加入会跳过为啥还让我加入，而且不能设置成自动加入不用我确认吗？我不是开了那几个目录自动嘛？»; 50 of 50 terms writes had added nothing)**: Dropline adds a word only if it would otherwise get it wrong (docs §5.2); a skipped entry `{term, reason}` — `review` = not needed (it already writes it right), `refused` = deleted before / dictionary full. Every skipped entry is KEPT (the journal row: words, `skips` with every field, `reasons` counted; ONE server log line, never a key) and the word is not proposed for 30 days; the dictionary read (`GET /v1/vocabulary`) is cached per account for a day and read again after each write; no card while the hour's six terms calls are spent. A folder set to automatic covers its SUBFOLDERS (a prefix rule) and asks NOTHING there: every proposable word goes (≤ 50 an hour), the rest wait (the toast «本小时额度已用完，N 个词稍后自动发»; the sheet lists them with the rule; the next dictation or the 10-minute tick sends them; a folder turned off drops them). The card's toggle names the folder it will cover (its path on hover) and offers the parent. The result says why: «已加入 0 · 跳过 11（Dropline：已能写对 9 · 词典不收 2）» in the toast, the journal row (each word's reason on hover) and the settings list's 加入 toast. Five writes in a row that added nothing ⇒ ONE low For-you item naming the reasons (停止发词 turns teaching off — the context switch stays; a later add closes it).
- **The gesture** (desk + phone): click to record (capsule «● 0:12 ▮▮▮ ✕», placeholder «Listening…»), click to stop, ✕ / Esc cancels with no request, 170 s stops by itself; the text lands at the cursor the box HAD at STOP (a selection is replaced; a box never focused takes it at its END); a 5-s chip «Inserted · Undo» («Inserted as spoken» when Dropline did not rewrite).
- **Every message box (lane voice-everywhere, 2.369.266; owner: "我在手机上想要回一下 inbox 里的东西，发现没有")**: ONE attach point `attachDictation(textarea, {getFacts, getCwd, openPlugins, placement})` → `{btn, chip, destroy}` (src/lib/voice-input.js; `createVoiceInput` = its chat flavour, placement 'chat'); `voiceField(ta, d)` wraps a box and its mic — the mic inside the box's trailing edge (24 px desk, 40×40 phone), its chip floating above it (fixed, in body, only while shown — never clipped by a row or a popover; a press on it is never an outside press). A resizable box keeps its drag grip (`.voice-field-grip`: the mic steps left of the corner). The placement CSS is app-wide (style.css). Attached: the chat composer, the For-you reply, the Inbox window reply, the channel / group / thread composers, a message to a path's callers, a group's opening context, an outbox draft being edited, the design comment + design brief, the doc comment, the goal condition, Custom review (showInputDialog `decorate`), the window-share note, a job panel's textarea. The census of every textarea under src/lib (attached, or the reason it is not a message box) = test-voice-boxes.
- **Every FOCUSED field (lane voice-follows-focus, 2.369.335; the owner: 「编辑或者拒绝 Agent 要发的消息」 could not be dictated into)**: dictation is a property of focus — `followFocus()` (app.js, once) binds ONE document focusin / focusout pair; a focused textarea, text input or [contenteditable] that PURE `dictationTarget` (src/voice-focus.js) calls a target and that has no microphone of its own gets one in a fixed `.voice-follow` host BESIDE the field (PURE `followPlace`: never over the field, the keyboard-yield strip or the buttons next to it; 28 px desk, 40×40 phone), re-placed on scroll / resize, gone on blur (a recording finishes first) or when the field leaves the page. Exclusions are the predicate, never a list: secret (password type, one-time-code / current- / new-password autocomplete), the terminal's helper, disabled, read-only, hidden, `data-no-dictation` (the SSH key / rclone.conf / pairing-code pastes), not text. The words land at the caret (a contenteditable by a Range; type=email at its end), `input` fires (unfocused: `change` too), a one-line box takes a dictated line break as a space — never an Enter; the context = the field's label + the dialog's title or the card's words (PURE `followFacts`, ≤ 600 chars). A press on the follower's microphone keeps the focus and is no popover's outside press (a window-capture pointerdown guard while one shows). The voiceField boxes and the composer keep their own microphone.
- **A dictation never closes the surface it fills (lane phone-tray-voice-done, 2.369.337; the owner's phone tray closed at the stop, twice)**: the stop held on the recording capsule — redrawn four times a second — is judged where it went down WHEN it went down (utils.js `onOutsidePress`), and a press on the voice UI outside every box (src/voice-focus.js `VOICE_UI`: the follower's microphone, a floating chip) is never an outside press of any popover, menu or tray. The Report a problem box takes dictation through the focus follower (its microphone over the modal).
- **The mic never focuses the box** (owner's decision for the phone, 2026-10-13): pointerdown + mousedown are cancelled on the button, it is out of the phone's tab order (tabIndex −1 ≤ 768 px; the desk keeps Tab), nothing is focused or blurred by it — a FOCUSED box (the keyboard already up, the desk) takes the words by `execCommand('insertText')` (its own Ctrl+Z undoes them), an unfocused one by `setRangeText`; the chip's Undo uses the box's undo when it holds the focus, else puts the old text back (only if nobody typed since). A box that leaves the page mid-recording cancels it (the 250-ms tick).
- **Absent, never greyed**: voice input off or no Dropline connected ⇒ no microphone anywhere (`html.voice-absent`, ONE class — no per-box listener): /api/voice/status at the first attach (≤ 1 read per 30 s, again when the tab comes back), the plugins-updated broadcast (app.js → `noteVoicePlugins`; the voice-input row's `enabled` = switched on AND keyed), the plugin card's own status read (`noteVoiceStatus`). An idle mic holds NO document listener (Esc is bound only while recording).
- **The context rule** (PURE `dictationContext`, ≤ 4 KB, this dictation only): app, title ≤ 200, before = tail 1 000 (sentence-aligned), after 500, selected 2 000, and — owner override 2026-10-12 — `text` = the last ≤ 6 user + agent TEXT messages (agent head 400, user 300), the working-directory name, ≤ 20 file names / identifiers, ≤ 1 500. Never: tool calls / results, thinking, system cards, compaction summaries (the user record the chat draws as a system card — THE chat's own `isCompactSummaryText`, src/assistant-note.js, voice-verify F1), hook frames, keys / env assignments / JWTs / `github_pat_`, e-mail, other conversations.
- **Failure words** (`voiceWords`, three languages): not https (+ the localhost address to copy, no microphone request), mic refused / absent, connect Dropline first / sign-in expired (+ Open Plugins), plugin off, rate limited {n} s (Retry-After), 180 s / 8 MB, unreadable audio, recognition failed (after the hub's one retry), not sent (blob kept 60 s, Resend).

## Plugins: install from a private Git repository; the cluster's plugin pre-trusted (lane engine-distribution, .356 — docs/design-custom-browser-plugin.zh.md §5)
⚙ → Plugins → **Install plugin…** → Git repository URL takes a **Ref** (a tag, a branch or a full commit sha — empty = the default branch) and a **Credential**:
- **None** — a public repository.
- **The Plugin Git credential** — ONE integration row (Integrations → Plugins → *Plugin Git repository*): the git host, plus an https access token (and its user name, empty = `x-access-token`) or an ssh deploy key without a passphrase (a text box: paste the whole key). It is sealed by the vault and handed to that host only. **Set up…** opens it; nothing secret is ever typed into the plugin form (the install route takes the credential by its row only).

At the clone, git receives the token through an askpass that reads a 0600 file, or the key through a 0600 file `ssh -i` names. Both files sit in a 0700 folder and are overwritten and removed on every way out — never in a URL, on a command line or in an environment value, and no configured git credential helper can store them. The clone fetches that one ref at depth 1 and records `{ref, sha, contentHash}`; **Update** re-pulls the recorded ref with the recorded credential.

Every failure is named and shown in the form: `plugin_git_spec` (the address or the ref is not one git can be handed — the words say why: a space or a line break in it, `user@host/path` is a local path, a `..` segment, …) · `plugin_git_credential` (none set, the vault locked, a credential for another host or of the wrong kind) · `plugin_git_auth` · `plugin_git_ref_missing` · `plugin_git_timeout` · `plugin_tree_rejected` (a symlink, an invalid manifest) · `plugin_git_failed`. The row's **Test reachability** runs `git ls-remote` with the credential against a repository this instance knows on that host.

**A cluster** ships the credential in its presets' `integrations.json` (`{id: 'plugin-git', values: {host, token}}`) and names the plugin in `customBrowser.source {git, ref}`. Each pod's boot job installs it when its record has no such id or a different source / ref — never a re-pull of the same. **D2 (the owner, 2026-10-25):** a plugin the cluster installed is pre-trusted and enabled with no dialog — the Plugins row says «Installed and trusted by the cluster · <sha>» — ONLY for the id `fleet.json` names, ONLY at a full commit sha it pins (a tag can move, so a tag is never the anchor), and ONLY while the installed package is the one trusted. Any of those changing ⇒ the owner is asked, like for any plugin. A plugin a person installs always asks once. A boot install that fails is said in the Plugins panel and as ONE For-you notice.

## Plugins: LLM (lane decision-core, 2.369.261 — docs/design-decision-api.zh.md; named LLM by lane llm-plugin-rename, 2.369.272)
**One key named by its provider, a switch per feature (lane llm-plugin-rename, 2.369.272 — the owner: 「openrouter key 这部分不适合继续叫 decision api 配置了 … 把整个 decision api 插件改名叫 LLM 插件之类的，然后里面可以开关各种功能」).** The plugin was «Decision API» (id `decision-api`); it is **LLM** (id `llm`, `provides: ['decision', 'text-model']`, src/plugins/llm.js). Its key card in ⚙ → System → Integrations & keys is «Language model (OpenAI / OpenRouter)» (registry row `llm`: provider + key ONLY; `usedBy` «Every feature of the LLM plugin uses this key»; step 3 «Turn on what you want in Settings › Plugins › LLM — each feature has its own switch»). All Settings › Plugins › LLM is ordered by FEATURE, each switch then its own rows: «Channels home: pick out the messages that need me» (`attention`) → its threshold, «What matters to me», «Learn from what I do» → the sentence rules (`rules`) → the hand-out (`routing`) → the For-you order (`inbox`) → «Judging model» (`judgeModel`, NEW — empty = the model the cluster chose while its key is in use, else the provider's default; it MOVED here from the card's old Model field) → «Draft “What matters to me” from my ✓ / ✗» (`learn`, NEW, default ON — the four judge switches stay OFF because each bills by itself; off ⇒ no 「从我的判定起草」 button and the learn route's 404 names the switch) → «Model that drafts…» (`learnModel`) → «Spend at most per day» (`dailyBudgetUsd`). Every row's words: what you get + ONE example + where it shows; no row says the old name or "judge" — 「判断模型」 is the word for the model that judges. Routes follow the id (`/api/plugins/llm/*`, `/api/integrations/llm/*`); the INTERNAL names stay (src/server/decision-engine.js, src/server/text-model-client.js, data/decision-memo.json / -usage.json / -journal.jsonl, the client's `provides(p, 'decision')`). The cluster env: `VIBESPACE_INTEGRATION_LLM_*` / a `VIBESPACE_INTEGRATIONS` entry `id: 'llm'`; the fleet's old spellings (`VIBESPACE_INTEGRATION_DECISION_API_*`, `id: 'decision-api'`) still resolve when the new ones say nothing (deploy/README.md). ONE migration `2026-10-llm-rename` moves settings.json / plugins.json / integrations.json (the card's model → `plugin.llm.judgeModel`). Census: test-plugins-grammar ④ — the old name is in no file under src/ scripts/ data/bin docs/agent public/ but the migration, the registry's legacy spellings and the legs proving them.
⚙ → Plugins → **LLM**: the owner's own switch (default off), feature toggles attention | rules | routing (default off), a daily budget in USD (stored as cents, default 100 = $1), today's counter per use, the privacy sentence naming the provider. The provider / key are the registry row `llm`'s own card (the judging model is the plugin's `judgeModel` row since lane llm-plugin-rename). The ONE caller is src/server/decision-engine.js: memo → RESERVE (budgetVerdict + the reservation in one synchronous step: the day's settled USD + every open reservation + this estimate against the cap, and the per-hour count, so N calls in flight with room for one make one call) → one fetch → SETTLE (the reservation is replaced by the vendor's recorded usage.cost, else kept as the cost — a 200 without usage is never 0; an answered 4xx / 5xx costs 0) → counter + journal (reserved → usd). The estimate = input tokens × the row's recorded cost per token once 20 calls said a cost, else 0.10/1M. 429 ⇒ its Retry-After (≤ 1 h), 5xx / no answer ⇒ 1 → 5 → 15 min, 401 / 403 ⇒ the card says Reconnect and no call goes until the key changes (a Test still may); never retried. The card's Today figure = settled + open reservations (lane decision-verify-fixes). D1 ships the core only — the attention rows (D2) and the `decision` rule kind (D3) call `judge()`.

**The ONE scrub (lane decision-input-scrub, 2026-10-13 — inbox-verify F1, a privacy blocker shipped since .261):** every vendor-bound part of every use (attention, rule, routing, For you, webhook) passes `cleanPart` (src/decision-model.js). It runs the tree's ONE secret table (src/secret-shapes.js `redactSecrets`, `{ runs: true }`) on the RAW text, before any cut; webhook payload strings are scrubbed before stringify. New table rows: R7 = URL query values named by a secret word (always on); R8 = nameless key material, hex / base64 runs ≥ 32 (opt-in, so stored command heads keep their shas). Addresses keep their domain (they are not secrets). Gates: test-decision-model «the ONE scrub» (per use, a straddling key, a grep-derived census of the part sites, RED controls), test-decision-engine H (the fake vendor's bodies, printed), test-exit-run §2b R7/R8 (+ RED control).

**The card's words (lane decision-card-words, 2026-10-13 — the owner on the .261 card: "这个看不明白啥意思，每个选项说法太抽象了"):** every control = what you get + ONE example + where it shows up. The switches read «Channels home: pick out the messages that need me» (attention) / «Notification rules can use a sentence as the condition» (rules) / «Hand messages to a task group or agent by what they say» (routing), each with an `Example: …` hint under it (`.decision-feature-hint`) that names its place (Channels home with the real «needs you · asks you» chip words, Notify…, a rule's «One of a list»); the budget row is «Spend at most per day (USD)»; the today line «Today: N checked · $x spent (limit $y)» keeps the same three numbers and moves the input tokens into its title (the per-use lines likewise). The registry row declares its own card words: `setup.title` «How to use it» + `setup.ordered` (the three steps draw as an `ol`), `choiceWords` for the radios («Use the key the cluster set up» / «Use a key of my own»), a caveat that says what «Passed» means, `usedBy` «Every feature of the LLM plugin uses this key» (was «Only the … plugin uses this key» before lane llm-plugin-rename); a row without them keeps the shared «Before connecting» / «Use cluster default» / «Use my own key». The Notify… refusals name the switches by these words. test-integration-registry pins the words and bans the engine's (judge / records / rows / first screen / route / predicate) on every string the card shows.

**Where the money shows (lane decision-spend-readout, 2026-10-13 — the owner on .264: 「你改的新的 UX 没办法看到 decision api 花了多少钱了」):** ONE PURE line, `decisionTodayLine(usage, capUsd, {on, t, monthUsd})` in src/decision-model.js, drawn VISIBLY in four places — never only a title: (1) the Plugins list row's second line under the description (`.plugin-row-fact`, a readout not a control: 「今天 $0.01 / $1.00 · 判断 60 · 命中 1」, red from 90 % of the cap, wraps in the narrow desk rail); (2) under the Settings budget row `plugin.llm.dailyBudgetUsd` (the full sentence 「今天：判断了 N 条 · 命中 M 条 · 已花 $x（上限 $cap）」); (3) the 需关注 block's judge line (its own counts + the line's money half); (4) Settings › 花费: a 「LLM · 今天 $x / $cap · 本月 $y」 row first in the section, with 打开设置 to the plugin's section. The by-use breakdown (「需关注 $0.009 · 托盘 $0.001 · 规则 $0」) is every line's hover. Money that moved is never $0.00: under a cent with calls > 0 is 「< $0.01」. Off ⇒ every place says 「LLM 插件已关闭——不花钱」. The month = the engine's status `month` (Σ usd of this local month's journal rows, a bounded 2 MB tail, kept 60 s). Live: src/lib/decision-readout.js re-reads GET /api/plugins/llm/status every 60 s while a line is drawn and patches it in place (the engine sends no usage broadcast).

**A refused plan or request stops the row; the owner's words in the questions are scrubbed (lane decision-vendor-hygiene, 2.369.267 — B-2979 + B-d375).** A 402 (the provider: the plan does not allow this model) and a 400 (the model refused the request shape) are ROW STOPS like a refused key (401 / 403 → Reconnect): one answer stops the row — no call until the key, the provider or the model changes; the owner's Test still calls and its 200 lifts the stop. One server notice per stop says what to do (⚙ → System → Integrations & keys); the Plugins row's chip says it («stopped — plan refused» / «stopped — model refused» / «stopped — key refused», warn) and its title the sentence; `status().stop` {why, status, at} and the plugin row's `why` name it; the journal row's outcome is `plan` / `shape`. A pass of 5 records under a 402 or a 400 is 1 call (was 5). Any other 4xx stays a per-call error. A rule's condition, a routing rule's option descriptions and a webhook rule's condition ride the QUESTIONS, not the input: `scrubQuestions` passes every string field of every question (identifiers kept) through the ONE scrub before the request is built.

**Rule learning — 「从我的判定起草」 (lane rule-learning, 2.369.269 — design q-037 P0, owner 2026-10-14).** The 我在乎什么 block can be DRAFTED by a text model from the owner's own verdicts, PROPOSED never written. It EXISTS only when the Language model row is OpenRouter with a key (the user's own or the cluster preset) and the plugin and its drafter switch («Draft “What matters to me” from my ✓ / ✗», `plugin.llm.learn`, default ON — lane llm-plugin-rename) are on — then the row's draft button reads 「从我的判定起草」 instead of the catalogue's 「从我最近的判定草拟」; otherwise there is no button and GET / POST /api/channels/decision/learn answer 404 `no-learn` (the catalogue draft stays the door). A press = ONE chat completions call (src/server/text-model-client.js, the ONE such caller — test-vendor-whitelist allowlists it with its gates) to OpenRouter with `provider: {zdr: true, data_collection: 'deny'}`: only zero-data-retention endpoints, never a provider that keeps data; no such endpoint (404 / a 400 naming the routing) ⇒ the card says 「所选模型没有零数据保留端点」 and NOTHING is sent without it. The input is only what the judge already saw — the block numbered line by line + ≤ 60 examples' ≤ 200-character digests (own first, implicit ones marked inferred), ≤ 4 000 tokens (PURE src/rule-learning.js `buildLearnInput`). The answer (strict JSON: lines keep / edit / add with the example numbers they rest on, removals with reasons, a note) passes six rules (`normalizeProposal`: ≤ 12 lines, the ONE scrub, example numbers checked, a line no example supports is 「无依据」 and unticked, duplicates out, block lines named must exist). The card (src/lib/learn-card.js) under the box: 「{model} 读了你的 n 个判定，提议 m 行」, the own / inferred counts, the ZDR sentence and the price; each line editable with its tick, kind chip (原样保留 / 改写 / 新增) and evidence chip (依据 #1 #2 — the digests in its tooltip); the lines it would remove (unticked; a line the answer never mentioned stays ticked); the model's note under ONE closed 技术细节 fold; 放弃 · 保存. 保存 writes the ticked lines through the row's own settings save (`decision.attentionBlock`, so the memo re-judges as today); the route never writes. Model: Settings › Plugins › LLM «Model that drafts “What matters to me”» (`plugin.llm.learnModel`: Gemini 3.8 Flash ≈ $0.007 a draft, the default; Sonnet 5.5 ≈ $0.02 — both through OpenRouter, never an Anthropic endpoint). Money: the judge's daily budget AND the use's own cap `learn` = $0.10 a day inside it (refusal `use-budget`), counted and journalled with every other use (by-use word 「起草判据」, the journal line's `zdr: true` + the vendor's usage.cost). The weekly digest (P1) is OFF and not wired. **Save never loses a line (lane rule-learning-fix, verify r1):** a keep with a valid line number IS the person's line, verbatim, whatever the model wrote (the 120 bound is for edits and new lines only); a line only an unsupported 「无依据」 row rewords stays in the kept list, ticked; the card COUNTS what 保存 would write — over 1 500 it says 「超出 1 500 字符（N）——去掉几行或缩短后再保存」 and 保存 waits, an empty result says 「保存后这一段为空」 and the button reads 「清空并保存」; the row's write door refuses an over-length value by name (「没有保存——N 个字符，最多 1500」), never a slice. One draft at a time (a second POST = 409 `busy`); a 3xx from OpenRouter is never followed (`redirect: 'error'` ⇒ `redirect`; the judge's fetch too); a request that never left the box releases its reservation ($0); every refusal has its sentence, anything else is 「没有起草——服务端出错」 with the raw text only under the 技术细节 fold. **Long lines, two lists, a long stored block (lane rule-learning-fix-r2, verify r2):** an edit or a new line over 120 characters is cut for its box at a word boundary (CJK at the character), never with an elision marker, is NOT ticked and says 「太长——已截短」, the model's whole text under that row's own 技术细节 fold — the line it rewords stays (「上面的改写太长、已截短——这一行保留」); the block's other lines sit under one header per kind — 「提议删掉的行」 (the named removals, unticked) and 「保留的原文」 (the lines that stay, ticked); ticking a rewording that was not pre-ticked unticks the line it rewords, which then says 「已由上面的改写替换——要留原文就取消上面的勾」; a block already stored over 1 500 (written around the box) is said at the card's top — 「原文已超过 1 500 字符（N）——保存前要截掉 M 字」 — with every stored line a row (nothing cut unsaid), while the model is shown only the judge's read (its first 1 500). The request is frozen and sent once; the vendor census sweeps every HTTP status on both tiers. **One rule for every rewording (lane learn-card-untick, verify r3):** a rewording — pre-ticked, 「无依据」 or cut — never takes the person's line by itself. That line keeps a row under 「保留的原文」: unticked while the rewording is ticked (「已由上面的改写替换——要留原文就取消上面的勾」), ticked when it is not (unticking a pre-ticked rewording gives the line back). The rewording row says 「已勾选：这一行将被改写」 / 「未勾选：原文不会被改写」. Once the person ticks or unticks their line themselves, the rewording's tick never moves it again. The stored-over-1 500 notice counts what 保存 would write and goes once that fits.

## For-you tray: the attention list (lane foryou-folds, 2.369.318 — design q-044 decisions 1 2 3 6 8, accepted by the owner 2026-10-19)
- **A conversation's own item is also a card in its chat** (lane chat-needs-you-card, 2.369.359): the same item, the same row and verbs, answered in either place — «Chat Mode».

**A refused background subject is ONE standing item (lane ledger-dedup-law F3, .361).** VibeSpace's own background work on a cluster machine (the usage harvest, a device-agent update, a job) that needs the owner's Allow files ONE item per machine × kind × WHO asks (the usage harvest and the writer sweep are two items, each in its own words; an Allow once lets only that one's next act go) that names what is not happening («Usage of M is not being recorded …», «The device agent on M waits for an update …»), never ends, and counts each later refusal in place (how often, the last time) — never a new 60 s card every 10 minutes (one fleet list held 958 expired cards). Allow once / Always on this machine / Deny answer it where it is (round 3: an answer covers only the subject it names — a background task's act never rides an agent's card, and a Deny stays until the owner allows that task again, a restart included — round 5: read when the hub starts, before the first act, and a re-ask after a Deny never reopens it); it closes by itself when its act is allowed another way (the machine's Hub automation, the instance-wide default) or after a week with no act («no longer asked»), and a restart re-judges it instead of keeping it. While the usage ledger is still loading at boot, nothing about money is decided from the part loaded: the estimates wait (the reading stands), no rate is learned, and the pool's automatic switch waits for the whole ledger. At the list's 1000-item cap the items that ended unanswered go first; an open item is never evicted. The memory notice names the process that holds the most by pid and command line, and says when it was not started by VibeSpace — an exec from outside the container.
- **A paste box in the tray** (lane vault-paste-request, 2.369.346): an agent's request for a secret (action `secret-request`, origin vault, high — band 2's «someone is waiting» like a held ask) draws its words above a MASKED field with 「存入保险库」 / 「拒绝」, answered right in the row (desktop popup, phone sheet, the mini inbox; the For-you window and the Vault band as a dialog); the row keeps the box across repaints and drops it when it resolves — see «Vault» below.
ONE PURE list, `src/attention-model.js` (`rowOf(item, now)` → a row; `needsMe(rows, now, policy)` → `{list, screen, folds, counts, parked, bands}`), read by the tray, its badges, the arrival toasts, src/decision-model.js `inboxPlace` / `inboxRank` and the For-you judge's pass. A row's BAND is a FACT, never the judge's word:

| band | holds (facts only) | order inside |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Urgent | urgency `urgent` (a login ending, a hub act card, a device alert) | newest first |
| 2 Someone is waiting | a plugin's reminder (pinned at its head — the owner's 「urgent 之下」; one filed `low` is band 5), an agent BLOCKED on the board for this ask (the pass's facts), a permission / helper ask held 60 s (`main-ask`, `helper-ask`, `exit-run-ask`), a person's direct / @-you row (`waitedBy: 'person'`, lane ②) | the plugins newest first, then the LONGEST waiting first |
| 3 A deadline or money | a `due` within 48 h (ahead, or passed < 48 h ago — the facts' date phrase), the attention judge's deadline_money clause (`deadlineMoney`, lane ②) | the nearest date first |
| 4 Needs your decision | option chips, a producer's button (`action`) or card | newest first |
| 5 Other questions | every other action row (normal / high / low) | NEWEST first; the inbox judge's score breaks only a same-minute tie; an answered row at the tail |
| 搁置 On hold | a row whose last ask is 7 days old (a plugin's reminder: 3) — never band 1, never a live date | newest first |

Notices never enter the list (a grey count). RISING is by facts only (a blocked board, a re-ask — `at` = the last ask —, an @, a date entering the window); a re-ask brings a row out of 搁置 back to the top of band 5. Constants: `CAP` 6, `PARK_DAYS` 7, `PLUGIN_FOLD_DAYS` 3, `DUE_WINDOW_MS` 48 h, `TIE_MS` 1 min; `policy = {cap, parkDays, pluginFoldDays, tieMs, expanded}` (lane ② adds its band switches / cap row; lane ③ draws the same list as the phone's first page).

**The tray (src/lib/user-todos-panel.js + user-todos-layout.js `bandLayout` / `bandEntries`):** the inbox page draws the bands in order as FLAT rows (each row names its conversation, its running dot in front — no group heads); a band's bar = its name + its open count + 「全部标为已看」 (ONE band's open rows, folded ones included; never on 紧急); the FIRST SCREEN is the first 6 rows of bands 1–5 (band 1 never folds — more urgent rows push it open); everything after folds BY BAND behind ONE head 「还有 N 条 — 展开」 that expands that band IN PLACE (keyed rows patched, never re-created; a band whose every row is folded — 搁置 always — carries its fold in its bar). While the popup is open the slots hold (the slot law): a resolved row stays struck in place, an arrival appends at its band's end and joins a fold that exists. Every open starts at the top. A band row's words are a TWO-LINE preview — measured (tools of the lane): production-length asks ran ~120 px a row and only 4 fit the 1280×800 popup; with the preview 6 rows + every head fit at 1280×800 (the popup's max-height is anchorFixedPopup's room above the taskbar, ~748 px — the CSS 480 px is overridden) and in the 375×812 sheet; the row's 「▸ 详情」 (or a reply box being typed) shows the whole words in place; the For-you window (⤢) always does. The NOTICES are one grey line (a button head with the count) that opens the unchanged chip strip + origin groups in one click (per open). The LLM plugin's three sections, their chip and the per-agent flood fold / board chip are retired (the For-you WINDOW keeps its session groups).

**Badges and toasts:** ~~the For-you badge (taskbar + phone nav) and the popup's Inbox tab count bands 1–4~~ — SUPERSEDED by «The honest count» below (lane foryou-honest, 2.369.358): bands 1–4 decide only what is LOUD (the coloured tiers by urgency, unchanged) + the grey notice count; band 5 and 搁置 are counted too, as ONE quiet segment. An arrival raises a toast (and blinks the button) only in bands 1–2 (`toastWorthy`); the rest move a number.

**The honest count, the marker, options as chips, one renderer (lane foryou-honest, 2.369.358 — the inline-answers stress evaluation: 21 agent questions open, every badge said «Nothing waiting on you», the Duo's list column spent five screens on chips that were not the options; the owner chose B, 2026-10-25).**
- **THE COUNT LAW** — a surface that holds the person's open questions COUNTS THEM ALL (kb-design-lessons): PURE `openCount(items)` (src/lib/user-todos-layout.js) = every open ACTION item whatever its band — a plain `vibespace-ask` lands in band 5 «Other questions» and is counted; notices stay the grey count. ONE sentence, PURE `badgeWords(loud, total, t)`: «Nothing waiting on you» ONLY at zero, «21 waiting on you — none pressing» with nothing loud, «1 urgent — waiting on you · 20 more, none pressing» otherwise. Every door says it: the taskbar button and the phone's top-bar button (one renderBtn: the loud tiers + ONE outlined `ut-seg-quiet` segment), the tray's Inbox tab and its head «N open», the For-you window's Actions tab, a chat window's title-bar badge (that conversation's count; its colour = its loud rows, else `quiet` outlined), and the Duo's bar, which now HAS For you (the regular class shows `#mobile-nav-todos`: landscape the bottom section's first destination — after Desktops, before Task Groups —, portrait before ⚙; its tray opens in the conversation column). A band the owner switched off changes only what is loud, never the number.
- **«needs you · N» ON A SESSION ROW** — every session row (`_buildSessionCard`: the Duo's list column, the phone's drawer, the desktop's sidebar) whose conversation holds open items carries ONE line: the inbox glyph, «needs you · N», the newest question's first line (PURE `sessionMark` / `firstLine`); a tap opens THE For-you window scoped to that conversation on its newest question (the row ⤢ road; on a phone the drawer steps aside). The Duo's inline answers (slice 2c: the question, its fold, four 44 px chips per question) are WITHDRAWN — the list marks, the For-you tray / window answers.
- **OPTIONS AS CHIPS** — PURE src/ask-options.js `optionsOf(detail, question)` parses the agent's habitual prose, and ONLY A CHOICE draws chips (acceptance round 2, 2026-10-25: an agent's numbered PLAN had become reply chips — a tap posted a fragment of the plan as the person's reply): «A …；B …；C …» (LETTERS, never bare numbers; 2–10, each ≤ 120 chars, an optional lead-in ending in a colon), or on ONE line «A) 北京 B) 上海» (A) A） A、 A: A： — never «A. do x B. do y», a sentence's own words); «1. 北京 2. 上海 — 选哪个？» (numbered ONLY with a choice cue around them — 选 / 哪 / 还是 / which / choose / pick / option / «or …?» — or a question that points at them, «选哪个城市？» over «1. 北京\n2. 上海» — never a go-or-wait question's 还是 / «or …?»; each ≤ 60 chars; an option's own «— safe» stays in its chip, the words after the list start at a new line or a dash followed by a cue); «是 / 否», «A / B / C», «yes | no» (ONLY one line ≤ 60 chars of 2–3 parts, with a question mark in the question or the detail); on every form the words after the last option («— 选哪个？», «— which?») are never part of its chip (round 4); distinct; anything else — a plan, a sentence, a path — draws none and the person types; `askOptions` = the agent's explicit `options[]` win. The model's `optionsFor` feeds the tray rows, the phone page, the mini inbox and the window's pane: «Reply: A 三处都改» … a chip sends its label through the reply road. (A parsed ask stays in band 5 — the band reads explicit options only.)
- **ONE RENDERER** — an item's question and detail are drawn by user-todos-row.js `wordsHtml` (plain text + the For-you links, every segment escaped) in the tray AND the For-you window's pane (line breaks kept) — the pane's markdown, which turned `__tests__/` into a bold «tests/», is gone (and with it a ```mermaid fence drawing in an item); the list row's sub line is the detail's first line verbatim.
- **THE TOUCH SCALE** (the owner 2026-10-25, 「按钮这么大，字这么小」): on a touch screen the tray's rows and chrome, the mini inbox, the For-you window and the marker read at ONE scale — text ≥ 14 px (the question and the pane's words 16), every target ≥ 44 × 44, the detail fold a full-width row, the row's four verbs labelled in one row (Reply weighted), option chips 15 px wrapping to two lines, every field 16 px (iOS never zooms); the mouse keeps its sizes. ONE row shape on a phone: the sheet's and the first-screen page's rows FOLD (the question in one line + one meta line, the whole row the tap, a trailing 44 px «Chat» door to the conversation; ONE open at a time) — six folded rows + the heads are the page's first screen (one line each: a band bar holding «Mark all seen» + «N more — expand» wraps to 92 px at 14 px, so two-line rows ended at 889 px on the production shape at 375×812). An OPEN row keeps its door on the question line (the question beside it, the door centred on its first line) and everything else — the «detail ▾» box first — below the door; the meta line is one run of text whose age keeps its dot («· 3min ago» never starts a line — a long conversation name wraps inside itself); a band's «N more — expand» is a full-width row AFTER its shown rows, where the rows it reveals appear (acceptance round 2).
- **✓ / ✕** on a row show ONE toast («Marked done» / «Dismissed») with Undo for 6 s — the ↺ road. **The tray head's ⤢** opens the window on All sessions (a window another device scoped to one conversation is widened, never inherited). **A tray row's body tap** opens it in place (the whole question, its detail fold) — the conversation's name in its meta line is the door there; on a touch screen the row is folded first (the tap opens it, its trailing door is the conversation). A RESOLVED row (kept in its band slot, or in Recently resolved) has nothing to open — its body goes to its conversation, and on a touch screen it keeps its «Chat» door.
- Gates: test-user-todos-honest (fast: every fixture shape, the bounds, the count + words with the base's RED CONTROL, the marker, one renderer with the base pane's markdown as RED CONTROL, the wiring) + test-foryou-honest-chrome (heavy: the 21-question fixture filed through the agent route at 951 / 382 touch and 1280 mouse, two pages; RED CONTROL: a bundle with the base's four rules; ⑤ ⑥ acceptance round 2 with the first commit's shapes as RED CONTROL) + test-duo-layout ④ retargeted.

**The judge is a tie-breaker (decision 3):** the For-you pass (src/server/decision-engine.js, every 5 min) writes every open action item's FACTS whatever the switch (free: the board's blocked / continued / finished, a date phrase, re-asks — the bands read them), and — only with ⚙ → Plugins → LLM → «For-you tray» on — judges ONLY `tieCandidates`: band-5 asks that share their minute with another (`status().inbox.untied` = the eligible rows the rule left alone). Its verdict orders that tie and nothing else (`now` above unjudged above `later`); it never moves a row between bands. The memo / re-file / version mechanics are unchanged (`judged {group, why, p, at, v, facts, sig}`). Measured on the production shape (14 days, counts only): 21 eligible asks a day → 1.1 ties a day (the journal showed 3–106 inbox calls a day).

**A plugin's reminder** (src/plugins/<id>.js `provides: reminders`; today Voice input · Dropline) files with origin **plugin**, its `plugin` id (the key) and a DOOR `open: {kind: 'plugin-settings', plugin, panel?, prefill?, done?}` (validated at filing). It heads band 2 (newest first, any urgency but urgent — an urgent one is band 1; one filed `low` waits in band 5 instead — Dropline's dictionary suggestion since lane voice-dictionary-nag) and folds into 搁置 after 3 days unclicked. A click on its BODY opens its door instead of looking for a session (Dropline's 「建议加入词库」 opens the Voice input sheet on that suggestion, its words chosen); ✓ = its `done` (add the words), × = dismiss, 「全部标为已看」 = acknowledged (on Dropline's suggestion both are «not now» — its ledger remembers).

**Decision 8 (src/server/device-alerts.js `upgradeIsNotice`):** an agent update pushed to a machine whose signature PASSED (`code` empty) and whose version goes FORWARD is a NOTICE (kind notice, normal — a fleet roll no longer files one urgent row per machine); a bad signature, a downgrade or an unreadable version stays urgent.

**The phone's first screen (lane phone-first-screen, decision 5):** `#phone-home` draws the same bands as a PAGE (src/lib/user-todos-panel.js `app.phoneHome` — its own slots, the tray's rowClick / reply / folds / 「全部标为已看」, the notices' grey line); it shows after the boot's restore when the first screen holds a row (not on a `?` link, over the wizard or after a press); every window open / focus hides it (window.js, but a remote apply); back = HOME (the page while it has rows, else the sidebar); the nav reads 待你处理 and hides its ✕ meanwhile. Measured at 375×812 / 390×844 on the production shape: 6 rows + 3 fold heads + the notices line end at 792 px with the two-line preview (whole words: 1161 px); six decision rows overflow by 55 px at 375×812 (cap 5 fits) — the cap stays 6 until the owner says. Gates: test-mobile-gaps, test-mobile-back-chrome F, test-back-guard, test-user-todos-layout ㉒. Lane foryou-honest (2.369.358): the page per tab in sessionStorage `vibespace.phoneHomeOn` ('1' / '0'; null = a cold open) + mobile-nav.js `shownAtBoot()` (this tab showed a window before) decide the boot — a reload with a window on show keeps it; the nav badge on the compact class toggles the page (`mBtn.onclick`), `#drawer-foryou` is the ☰ drawer's first row; the accordion is user-todos-panel.js `openOne` (touch only, `isTouchDevice()`), the folded row is style.css's touch block. Gate: test-foryou-honest-chrome ④ (RED CONTROL ⓪: the base's boot lands on the page again). After round 2, MEASURED in ⑤ (the fixture, one band): 6 folded rows (52–54 px) + 1 band head (44) + the fold row after them (44) end at 463 px at both 375×812 and 390×844, scrollTop 0.

Measured (lane foryou-folds, the production shape, counts only): the first screen 36 open rows → 6; toasts 38.8 → 1.0 a day; the badge 31 → 12. Gates: test-attention-model (fast, PURE: the shape, the band table, the cap / urgent / park legs, MUTANTS p-across-bands and no-cap), test-user-todos-layout ⑨ ⑩ ㉑ ⑬, test-decision-inbox ⑧, test-device-acts ⑦ (decision 8 + mutants), test-inbox-reply-ui ④ ⑨ ⑮ ⑯ ⑱ ⑳ (heavy: the first screen measured at 1280×800 and 375×812).

**The owner's switches (lane attention-predicate-shared, 2.369.319 — decision 4).** Settings → Toolbar & Layout → «What needs me · the bands» (block `bands`): one switch per band — `attention.band.urgent` · `waiting` · `dated` · `decide` · `ask` · `parked`, on by default — and `attention.cap` (6; 4–8) for the first screen's size. A band OFF ⇒ its rows sit in band 5's order, count in no badge and never toast; 搁置 off ⇒ nothing parks (those rows sit in band 5); band 5 off ⇒ its rows never take a first-screen row (they wait behind its fold). A switched-off band that moved rows is SAID once — under band 5's bar in the tray, under band 5's name on the Channels first screen ("Someone is waiting is switched off — 2 of its rows sit with Other questions"), never silently empty. ONE reader: `settingsPolicy(get, extra)` in src/attention-model.js — the tray, its badges and toasts, a chat window's title-bar badge, the Channels first screen and its rail badge, the sidebar's rank (test-attention-model ⑬'s census reds any other read of the keys). A change re-renders every surface live (the settings broadcast). No per-origin filter (design §5).

**A band's fold is a TOGGLE in a fixed slot (lane attention-predicate-shared — the owner 2026-10-19 on the .318 tray: 「很容易误触」, after 展开 the fold left the bar and 「全部标为已看」 slid under the finger).** The bar's right end holds 「全部标为已看」, then the toggle in one fixed width: 「还有 N 条 — 展开」 ⇄ 「收起」 (folds back exactly the rows 展开 showed — `bandLayout`'s `collapse`); a band that folded during this open keeps the toggle's slot even when nothing is held back any more (hidden, never removed). Nothing destructive ever occupies a spot a non-destructive control just vacated (test-inbox-reply-ui ⑮ reads both rects before / after a real press, then presses the same spot again: it collapses, nothing is marked). The Channels 「需要我」 band heads use the same toggle.

**The same list feeds Channels and the sidebar (lane attention-predicate-shared, decision 7).** A Channels conversation's wait facts (src/channel-focus.js `attentionRowOf`) are placed by the SAME `bandOfRow`: a person who wrote to you directly or @-mentioned you, or the judge's `waiting` clause ⇒ band 2; the judge's `deadline_money` ⇒ 3; a draft awaiting your approval or a send nobody confirmed ⇒ 4; another judged row ⇒ 5. The sidebar ranks sessions by their band first (`sessionRowOf`: urgent ⇒ 1, a running agent blocked ⇒ 2, asking you ⇒ 5; the old urgency rank orders inside a band).

## Channels: API access (B-2198 raw API; 完全信任 lane api-tier-write-all, 2026-10-13)
Four tiers per (credential, principal), widen-only (MAX over the agent's own row, its groups, All agents): **Read** (reads run, a write is refused), **Read + write, ask each** (every write is a card), **Read + write, auto** (writes run; a sensitive call — DELETE, the vendor's sensitive paths, a big body, an upload — still asks), **完全信任 / Full trust** (`write-all`: sensitive calls run too, without a card — each such call's API log line and chat row say 「完全信任 · 敏感」; still under the daily cap). **The everyone rule:** All agents sit at Read by default, a write tier for them needs the "every agent writes" tick, and Full trust is NEVER theirs. **Full trust names ONE principal** (lane tier-verify-fixes, tier-verify M1): only a single agent / conversation row (`principal.kind === 'agent'`) may hold it — a Task Group is refused like All agents, since its members join by cwd and a group row would reach conversations nobody named. Refused at the row (channel-acl validateGrant + channel-api apiGrant, reason `write_all_named_only`; the PUT answers 400 with that code), at the dialog (on a group / All row the option is disabled and says 「完全信任只能给单个 agent 或对话；岗位、规则和"所有 agent"最高到"读 + 写，自动"」) and capped to write-auto in effectiveApi if a stored row says otherwise. **Two log lines:** granting Full trust writes a `granted` line in the credential's API log (who, when, by whom), and lowering any tier (any step down; a removal = none) writes a `lowered` line of the same shape with `from` → `tier` (the dialog: 「你将 {who} 的档位改为 {tier}」); both pinned by fast legs in test-channel-api (tier-verify L1/L2). The agent reads its tier by name in `vibespace-channels api creds` (`tierSays`).

**The API log (lane channel-api-log-blank, .336 — the owner 2026-10-21 「这个 API 日志为啥一直是空的」).** The dialog's log lists that credential's last 20 lines, newest first: every call an agent made through it — ran, asked you, approved or rejected by you, refused (by the fence, the budget, a missing grant, or an Approve that ran nothing), withheld — plus the 完全信任 grant and tier-lowered lines; calls from before .336 are there too (the engine has written them since the raw API shipped). It is never blank: 「加载中…」 at once, then the lines (patched in place on a re-draw), 「还没有调用」, or ONE line 「无法读取 API 日志：<reason>」. It keeps its height however long the roster above it (it was squeezed to 0 px under a roster at the picker's cap — the heading with nothing under it); the dialog scrolls instead.

**The redirect rule (lane raw-api-redirect-judge, 2.369.274, B-fc37).** A vendor's 301 / 302 / 303 / 307 / 308 is never followed by itself: its Location becomes a request again (https, the SAME host — never another, not even another of the credential's own —, the fence's path rules; 303 ⇒ a GET without the body) and goes through THE SAME judge as the call, under the tier held at that moment. It is followed only when that judge would run it without a card AND it does no more than the call (a read never becomes a write, a write never a sensitive call, one approved request never another); ≤ 5 hops, a revisit stops. Otherwise NOTHING is sent there: the agent gets `api_redirect_unjudged {from, to, why}` (or `api_redirect_loop`), the API log line names where (method + host + path, never the query), and an approved card says 「服务方把它重定向到了别处 — 未跟随」 with the target under 技术细节 and the door 「重新提交」 — which files that target as a NEW card (its own words, chip and digest) for the user to decide; nothing runs on the press. Off-host, a refused tier, a bad path or a loop offer no door.

**The tray stays through a dictation; every close says why (lane phone-tray-voice-done, 2.369.337 — inc-mvhzgiq8-bs3j):** a reply dictated on the phone — start, stop, the 「Inserted · Undo」 chip, the keyboard showing and folding — never closes the tray; Escape folds the reply box first (its draft kept), and every closer (`hidePopup(why)`) leaves `{op:'popup-hide', panel:'for-you', why}` in the incident recorder's op ring — outside / frame / escape / back / jump / artifact / open-win / view / answer / button.

## Channels: judged rows (lane decision-attention, 2.369.261 — docs/design-decision-api.zh.md §2.4)
With the LLM plugin on and its "needs attention" feature on, the Channels first screen also lists rows no fact tag claims that the judge thinks need the owner now: the chip "需要你 · 0.82 · 问你、截止或钱款" (p + the rubric clauses in our words, never the vendor's) and ✓ / ✗ — each a labeled example (data/decision-examples.json, newest 200, 12 sent per call); ✗ drops the row at once. One record per call, ≤ 3 in flight, the rows drawn first and the verdict patched in; D1's memo means a redraw / reload / restart never re-bills (a new label or a new "what matters to me" text re-judges at the next read). ⚙ → Channels: "What matters to me" (≤ 1 500 characters, your words as written, + "Draft from my recent decisions" = proposed lines, saved only by you) and the advanced threshold (0.50–0.90, default 0.70). Account ⋯ "Never judge this account".

**The judge gets FACTS, not more text (lane decision-attention-facts, 2.369.266 — the owner: 「decision api给的优先级评估都不怎么样」).** Each record opens with a `facts:` line the PRODUCT measured (src/decision-model.js `attentionFacts`): addressed (@-mentioned the reader — the at-you rule's `FO.mentionsSelf` / `FO.atYouOf` · a direct message · a reply to the reader's message · no mention), kind (a direct message / a group of N when the vendor counted / an email thread), when the reader last spoke here, N messages since the read line, the same mail in K of the owner's mail accounts (subject + sender within 60 min, ONE map per scan), the gmail `automated` level. Counts, kinds, ages — never a name, id or address (census in test-decision-model ⑬). The facts are input, NOT memo material: a row is judged again on a new message, never on a new read. The body = what the reader has not read (past `readAt`, newest first, ≤ 12 whole messages + "(N earlier unread messages omitted)"; unknown read line ⇒ the last 8); mail is `trimMailBody`-ed (quotes, `-- ` signature, a footer past 40 %). RUBRIC v2: `to_me` trusts the facts line; `matters` only when 「我在乎什么」 is non-empty; the [rubric] part is one line. The journal line carries `p`. **「从我的行为学习」** (插件 › LLM, `decision.implicitLabels`, default OFF): at most once an hour, a reply after a judged message within 24 h of the verdict ⇒ an implicit "needs" example, a row listed ≥ threshold and left unopened + unanswered 24 h ⇒ "not" (`source: 'implicit'`); the person's ✓ / ✗ always win, go first in the 12 sent and are never replaced; off ⇒ nothing written.

## Channels rules: the `decision` kind + routing (lane decision-rule, 2.369.261 — docs/design-decision-api.zh.md §2.5 / §6 D3)
Notify… → "Only messages matching a rule…" → **is judged by the LLM plugin**: the condition in plain words (≤ 500), yes/no (a hit at p ≥ the threshold, 0.50–0.90, default 0.70) or one of a list (≤ 8 options + the implicit `none`); an option may ROUTE to a Task Group / an agent that holds access — the route hits only on that principal's own notification row, so put the same rule on each target's row (asked once per message). The rule's own cap: judgments per hour (1–60, default 20). The row's cost line = records a day in scope × D1's token ceiling × the price, against the plugin's daily budget; the plugin off / no key / its `rules` (or `routing`) switch off is said on the row with Open Plugins. The engine pre-judges each fresh record ONCE (every decision rule in scope = one call, the memo means a re-pass or a restart never re-bills); a refusal is no hit + one server log line per rule per hour; a hit wakes through the usual ladder with `why` = `decision: <condition> → 0.82` / `→ <route> 0.85`. Agents: `vibespace-channels watch <conv> --kind decision --condition "…" [--choice a,b] [--threshold 0.7] [--per-hour 20]`.

**A judged rule that cannot run is SAID (lane judged-watch-state, 2.369.337, B-f42e):** one PURE verdict (`judgedRoadState`: the plugin, its switch, the key, today's money, the rule's hour) is read by the paid call's gate and by every door — the agent's `watch` answer ends «judged rules: live (today's budget N% used)» or «will NOT run: <why> — the rule is saved and starts <when>», `watch --show` / `watches` say it per row, the Notify… row carries a chip (live · paused: budget spent · off: rules switch); a message skipped meanwhile is never a «no» — kept (in memory) and judged when the road returns, within the reply-judging window; the rule's agent gets ONE next-turn line a day per cause; the owner ONE low For-you row a day when the budget paused judged rules (the door = the plugin's budget setting).

**A plain reply, judged (lane dm-reply-infers, 2.369.332, B-6b4b):** the reply rule (`reply-to-sent`) has an opt-in box «Also judge plain replies» (`infer: true`; the CLI `--reply-to-sent --infer`): a peer's message with NO quote / thread marker that arrives within `channels.replyInferHours` (default 24) of the principal's own send in the same chat is judged ONCE by the LLM plugin (use `reply-infer`: the sent text + the reply + the gap, nothing else; memo = record + send, never re-judged; the Rules switch, the daily budget, 20 an hour per conversation) — p ≥ 0.80 wakes the sender with «judged an answer to your message of <time>» and the score; a marker hit stays the marker road, unjudged.

**The turns between (lane reply-infer-owner-between, 2.369.339, agent feedback fb-377439b167):** the judge also sees what was written in the chat between the send and the plain reply, as a fixed line (`between`):
- how many messages the person who owns the chat wrote of their own, the last one's kind (a text message / a voice note, not transcribed / a picture / a file) and how many minutes before the reply, plus how many came from others;
- or «Nobody else wrote between sent and reply.».

How it is read and judged:
- It reads at most the newest 5, from the conversation's own records (the thread index, never a vendor call). An agent's send never counts as the owner's.
- The question is v2: a reply that follows the owner's own message more closely scores low unless its words clearly answer the agent's message. v1 answers are not reused.
- A yes after the owner's own message says «…; the user also wrote in between», and the hand-over line names the kind and the minutes («a voice note, 3 min before this»).
- Voice notes are not transcribed (a billed call per note; the owner's decision).

### Agent browser — a page nobody watches stops drawing, by default (lane idle-paint-default-on, the owner 2026-10-20 「可以」)
An agent's browser on a screen nobody can see (the hidden window, or headless) stops drawing once nobody has watched it and no command has driven it for 30 s: its pages are frozen. The next command thaws it before it runs, and opening its live view brings it back within a frame (31–43 ms measured, then 60 fps). On the fleet image, a dashboard nobody watched kept the browser's GPU process at 99.8 % (a light page at 4 %); frozen, it used 0 %. It is the setting **Stop drawing in a browser nobody watches** (`browser.idlePaintFreeze`, Agent browser, advanced): on unless the owner turns it off, and an instance whose owner set it keeps what it set. A frozen page's own scripts and timers pause too, so a page that must keep working with no command and no viewer only moves while commands run or someone watches.

### Agent browser: passkeys (lane passkey-store-core, 2026-10-12, docs/design-passkey-store.zh.md)
Every watched tab of an agent browser carries its OWN CDP virtual authenticator (enable + add as one step, `enableUI:false`), EMPTY between ceremonies. The page's `navigator.credentials.get/create` (and autofill gets) are HELD by the main-world hook; the dialog watch judges each by PURE `gateVerdict` and loads ONLY the matching rows for that ceremony (the sign count bumped on disk first), then unloads everything at its end. Registration needs the owner's card first (`vibespace-browser passkey register <site>` ⇒ allow once = one key in 10 min); a new key's policy is `ask` (a card per sign-in, "always"/"never" remembered); a per-profile switch turns agents off; the person's own takeover ceremonies raise no card (source "you"). Keys live sealed in data/browser-passkeys.json (0600) + data/browser-passkeys.key (0600), per VibeSpace instance — a copied profile directory carries none; a removed profile takes its keys with it. A watch that dies mid-ceremony leaves no hang: the hook rejects in-page after 1.5 s (P0 ④) and the re-attach rebinds it.

**The hook's identity (lane passkey-prewrap-fix, 2026-10-13, passkey-verify lens ②):** the watch never talks to whatever sits at `CredentialsContainer.prototype.get` — that slot stays `configurable` (a locked slot is a fingerprint), so a page can put its own function there. The hook stamps its control function `ctl` in a PRIVATE field of the prototype under the profile's random slot name (`pkSlot`, a locator, not a credential); the watch finds it with `Runtime.getProperties` (privateProperties) and calls it with `Runtime.callFunctionOn` (`PK.CTL_FN`, a direct call). The binding name and the control key are minted per ARM (`e.pk.binding` / `e.pk.key`); new documents get the hook from `addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` (never `runImmediately`), documents already open are reached by identity (`pkReach`: found ⇒ `REARM_FN` hands the new key and retakes a displaced slot; none ⇒ the hook evaluated in; two ⇒ neither called). A page that replaced the API is said once per tab document: the trace row ("the page replaced its passkey API — VibeSpace took it back"), a log line and the Passkeys card's note ("A page replaced the credentials API (taken back)", `passkeyList().displaced` = the episodes of the last hour). The old key is refused after a re-arm. **The report binding is isolated-world (lane passkey-binding-isolated, 2026-10-14, B-7c9a — §2.8's residual closed):** `Runtime.addBinding` is armed with `executionContextName`, so the per-arm binding lives only in the hook's isolated world and never on the page's main-world global; the main-world hook reports by dispatching a per-profile SECRET-named CustomEvent on `document` (dispatch + CustomEvent captured at document start) and the isolated-world reporter (`installReporter` / `reporterSource`) holds the binding and forwards it (new documents via `addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument{worldName}`, a live document on a re-arm via `createIsolatedWorld` + `evaluate`); `Runtime.bindingCalled` arrives from the isolated context and the watch maps it to the document's main-world context by frameId. A page polling global names can no longer see the binding nor forge trace / card events (measured 16/16 re-arms → 0/16); no key, no cross-origin.

### Agent browser: the Passkeys table and cards (lane passkey-ui, 2026-10-12, P2 of docs/design-passkey-store.zh.md)
A profile row's ⋯ menu has **Passkeys (n)…** (n from the profiles digest's `passkeyCounts`, 0 too): desk = a fold-out section under the row, phone = a bottom sheet (src/lib/browser-passkeys-view.js). It shows the agents-never switch (ONE PUT) and the sentence "Keys live only in this VibeSpace; deleting the profile deletes them", then Site · User · Source (agent / you + date) · Last used · Policy. Policy is a three-way allow / ask each time / never control: ONE PATCH, and the row is patched in place. Then ⋯ Delete…, whose confirm names the site and the user. **The passkey card** (`pk-…`, register: Allow once / Not now; sign-in: Allow once / Always allow / Not now / Never) is ONE set of words, `passkeyCardWords` in src/browser-passkey.js: who asks for what, what the agent may do after, the outcome + the policy in force once decided. It is the For-you row (choices as `pk:<choice>` answers; the item's `action.choices` is ONE space-joined string because user-todos refuses arrays), the chat card (the watch's `passkey-proposal` event ⇒ `normalizers.feedProposalCard`, live only) and the live view's `passkey_ask` banner (`stuckForKey` carries the open card). Each posts `/api/browser/proposals/pk-…/approve {shown, choice}`; an allowing primary obeys the press-arm rule. The `passkey_open` banner and For-you words say the three sentences: a site with no key offers its own other ways in, a kept key follows its policy, and a new one needs your permission. Replay rows read "registered a passkey on <rp>", "signed in with <user>'s passkey on <rp>" or "refused: …" (browser-trace commandText).

### Agent browser: passkeys on the custom kernel (lane passkey-sink, 2.369.356, P2 of docs/design-custom-browser-plugin.zh.md §3)
On a browser engine whose kernel lists the feature `webauthn` (the custom kernel), a website's passkey sign-in or registration is answered BY VIBESPACE with the passkey it keeps sealed for the profile — the same Passkeys table, the same policy per key, the same cards. The kernel never shows a passkey window of its own and never falls back to the computer's or Google's password manager; VibeSpace does not pair a virtual authenticator there (standard Chrome keeps today's road, unchanged).

- **Who signs.** VibeSpace's server signs the ceremony with the key sealed in data/browser-passkeys.json (PURE src/webauthn-sign.js — ES256; a new passkey is a P-256 key made on the server, sealed before the site ever sees it, registered with attestation `none`). The key never leaves the server; every signature and every new key is a USE of the passkeys' key in the vault's own use log (purpose + receipt, never the key), so `vibespace-vault uses` shows the agent its own.
- **What UV means.** The «user verified» flag the site reads is set only when the owner decided THIS ceremony: answering the passkey card (Allow once / Always allow), the registration card's one-time permission, or the person signing in by their own hands in a takeover. A key whose policy is «allow» signs without a card and WITHOUT UV — and a site that requires UV gets the card instead of a signature without it.
- **What the page sees on cancel.** `vibespace-browser passkey cancel` (or the live view's Cancel) ends the ceremony through the kernel: the page sees `NotAllowedError` (not the AbortError of standard Chrome's hook), and the sentence says so. Every refusal also ends in NotAllowedError, with its reason kept for the agent's next commands: the existing ones (no permission yet, policy never, declined, expired, passkeys off, the site's own address may not use it) plus three of the kernel road — the site offered no ES256 key type, the request is not the page's own (VibeSpace re-checks the address and, when the kernel hands it, the signed client data — never trusting the kernel), and the saved passkeys cannot be opened (the vault is locked: the owner already has the item; the agent is told never to ask them).
- **What the agent sees.** Exactly today's record: `[passkey_ask]` while the owner's card waits, `[passkey_open]` if a ceremony stays open, a refusal said for a minute, `passkey status|cancel`. The kernel's passkey prompt never shows up as a second `[dialog_open]`, and the owner gets ONE card, the passkey card.

### Agent browser: web logins on the custom kernel (lane browser-login, 2.369.356, P3 of docs/design-custom-browser-plugin.zh.md §4)
On a browser engine whose kernel lists the feature `credentials` (the custom kernel), the password manager is VibeSpace's vault: the kernel reports each login form a page shows, VibeSpace fills it with a login the vault keeps — the agent never sees the password or the two-step code — and when the page takes a form the vault saves what it should. Standard Chrome reports no form: there `vibespace-browser login` says so (`login_no_form`) and the owner signs in by hand in the live view.

- **The entry.** A website login is ONE vault entry `web-login:<origin>#<user>` (the site's exact origin — its scheme, host and port — and the user name lower-cased), its value the sealed record (user name, password, an optional paired two-step entry, where it came from). The Vault window lists them under **Web logins** (「网站登录」) as «user · site» with where each came from: **By you** (added with 添加 → 网站登录…), **Registered by an agent · its password made by the vault, never shown**, or **Typed by an agent itself · strength unknown — the agent knows it** (with «Rotate suggested»). 显示 shows the password behind the second password; 删除 removes it (and its own grant).
- **Who may have it filled — 用于….** The owner picks a scope and who: **This account**, **Any account on this site** (this also lets an agent REGISTER new accounts there, through the vault) or **Any site** — for running conversations, Task Groups or everyone. It is a row of the one grants store (door `browser-login`); 除了 subtracts as everywhere. No grant ⇒ `login_not_granted`, and the agent is told where the owner grants it.
- **Signing in.** `vibespace-browser login [<origin>] [--user <name>] [--submit]` fills the form on the conversation's own tab: the form must be the page's own (the agent naming another site, a form inside another site's frame, or a site not on https — http only on this machine's localhost — is `login_phishing`), exact to the port (a subdomain, a sibling domain or another port never gets the login), ONE login of that site (several ⇒ `login_ambiguous`, pass `--user`). The kernel checks the page's origin again before it fills. The answer names what was filled (the user name, the password, the two-step code) and a receipt — never a value; each fill is a line in the vault's use log (`vibespace-vault uses`). A login paired with a two-step entry fills the page's code field too (the login grant covers it — D3). An HTTP sign-in prompt on the kernel is answered the same way.
- **Registering through the vault.** `vibespace-browser login [<origin>] --new-user <name> --generate [--submit]` on a sign-up form: the vault makes a 20-character password that honours the site's rules (its minimum / maximum length and pattern — a rule no strong password meets, like a six-digit PIN, is refused `password_rules_unsupported`), SEALS it in the vault before the page sees it, and the kernel fills it. When the page takes the form the login is saved automatically (registered by an agent, in the conversation it was made in) and ONE For-you notice tells the owner — informational, never an approval. `login --user <name> --generate` on a change-password form changes the password the same way, the old one kept for one revision.
- **A password the agent typed itself.** If an agent signs up by typing a password itself (bypassing `--generate`), the page's submission is still saved automatically — marked typed by the agent, strength unknown — and the notice says so; never discarded. The same password submitted again changes nothing; a different one for a kept login updates it (the old one kept one revision, the notice says «updated»). A submission while the vault is locked is held and written at the next unlock.
- **What the kernel sends on a submission** (lane engine-distribution, settled with the kernel side 2026-10-25): when the password box still holds the value the vault filled, the kernel's `credentialSubmitted` carries NO password. A vault-minted signup or change is then confirmed from the pending entry; a saved login submitted unchanged writes nothing. Only a value someone typed over the box (the agent typing, a person in a takeover) rides the event — loopback CDP only — and is saved as typed by the agent, or offered to the owner. The fake kernel's `omitFilledPassword` mode is that kernel.
- **A person's own sign-in.** When the owner signs in by hand in a live-view takeover, a For-you card asks «Save the login … to the vault?» (Save / Update / Not now) — the password is held only until it is answered (10 minutes at most).

### Agent CLIs taught — ONE registry of the CLIs on PATH (lane cli-registry, 2026-10-18; the owner: a top-level list of the agent CLIs with their one-liners, its length limited and tested, one source of truth)
`src/agent-cli-registry.js` (PURE) holds one row per agent CLI VibeSpace puts on PATH — 13: vibespace-status / -ask / -task / -job / -channels / -msg (TAUGHT: a copy-ready SessionStart paragraph and / or a per-turn reminder segment), vibespace-page / -design / -exit / -window / -browser / -app (INDEX-ONLY: named in the docs pointer and the index, never injected), vibespace-docs (the pointer itself). Each row: name, manual topic (+ aliases: `app` = `apps`), a summary ≤ 140 B, the manual file(s) under docs/agent, a gate the hook already evaluates (the status / ask / task / jobs toggles, `channels` = the session's reach word, `always`). A closed gate omits the row from EVERY surface.
- **What renders from it:** the Task-Group SessionStart "Reporting back" section (header count = the paragraphs that rendered; every toggle and the reach closed ⇒ no section), the per-turn reminder's `Tools on PATH:` line (its `vibespace-docs [status|ask|task|jobs|channels|msg|pages|design|exit|window|browser|apps]` pointer = every open row's topic in row order), the docs topics `GET /api/agent/docs/:topic` serves, and the table `vibespace-docs` prints with no argument (docs/agent/index-manual.md's generated block + its usage line; `node scripts/test-cli-registry.mjs --write-index` rewrites it).
- **What does not:** the no-group tools intro (`sessionToolsIntro`) keeps its own lines — its 4 096 B cap (test-prompt-budget ②) and its browser facts; the census holds every `vibespace-<x>` it names to a row. The absolute-paths + Artifacts line is the section's trailer (task-groups), not a row.
- **The caps (RED in test-cli-registry):** the SessionStart section ≤ 2 725 B with every gate open (measured 2 561 + the 164 B test-prompt-budget ③ leaves the three-group shape), the reminder line ≤ 1 200 B (measured 1 077 + room for one channels-size segment), a summary ≤ 140 B. Every teaching shape (scripts/measure-prompt-context.mjs `teachingShapes`, 18) is pinned in scripts/fixtures/cli-registry-renders.json to its 4a14bcc2 render or to a pinned change with its reason.
- **A new CLI on PATH:** a row (or an EXCLUDED reason in test-cli-registry: hooks, wrappers, modules, remote helpers, the hidden browser driver) — the census over the generators' writes, tracked data/bin, HostManager.AGENT_TOOLS and the build outputs is RED until it has one.

### Agent feedback — `vibespace-feedback` + ⚙ System ▸ Agent feedback… (lane agent-feedback, 2026-10-18; the owner: agents report what felt wrong through a command, the maintainers read the reports to improve the system, the owner sees them in the interface)
An agent runs `vibespace-feedback "what felt wrong, and where" [--about <tool|flow>] [--kind cli|flow|ui|docs|other]` (ONE text argument — the agent-cli-text rule; `list` = its own reports). `POST /api/agent/feedback` validates the body (src/feedback-model.js: text 1–2000 characters, controls / bidi stripped; about ≤ 60; kind) and fills the caller's facts from the TOKEN: the conversation, its sidebar name, its Task Group, the harness name, the instance name + version. data/feedback.json (src/server/feedback-store.js) keeps ≤ 500 records; the least recently reported one is dropped and counted.
- **The same report is counted, not repeated:** same normalized text + about within 24 h of its last report, any session ⇒ `count` + 1 on the existing record (`duplicate: true`; the CLI says "already reported … ×N").
- **Pacing:** one report per 10 s per session (429 `paced`, Retry-After).
- **Live everywhere:** every change is mirrored into the `feedback` StateSync store, which is SERVER-OWNED (`clientWrites: false` — a client's state-set into it is refused; no file of its own; its version persisted with the records). The owner's sheet (src/lib/feedback-sheet.js) loads it on the first ⚙ open and patches keyed rows in place; the ⚙ row wears the open count.
- **The owner's acts:** `GET /api/feedback` (newest report first, open, dropped) and `PATCH /api/feedback/:id {status: open|handled}` — cookie only (an agent bearer ⇒ 403 agent_forbidden), cross-site writes refused by the write-origin gate.
- **Teaching:** a registry row (src/agent-cli-registry.js, gate always): a 152 B SessionStart paragraph + an 88 B reminder segment; manual docs/agent/feedback-manual.md. Nothing is sent off the instance unless it has a telemetry forward target (One inbox for the fleet, below).
- **The maintainer marks what it fixed** (lane feedback-handled-verb, the owner 2026-10-20 「你处理过的 agent 反馈你怎么不进行标记呢？」 — the maintainer shipped fixes but only the owner's cookie could mark a report): a conversation the owner granted an automation key holding `feedback.list` / `feedback.handled` reads the OPEN reports with their ids (`vibespace-api call feedback.list` — other agents' words, belted) and marks one handled naming the release that shipped the fix (`vibespace-api call feedback.handled --id fb-… --version 2.369.330 [--note "…"]`). It is the owner's own Mark handled — the same feedback-store call — so the sheet, every open client and data/feedback.json move together; the row says «handled in 2.369.330 by <conversation>» with the note under it, the owner's own click still «handled <when>», and the reporter's `vibespace-feedback list` says `handled in 2.369.330`.
- **One inbox for the fleet** (lane feedback-forward, 2026-10-20 — the owner 「这个功能本来就是给你用的，你自己开发个处理流程」):
  - **The forward:** an instance with a telemetry forward target (its settings, else the fleet pods' VIBESPACE_TELEMETRY_FORWARD_URL / _TOKEN) forwards every NEW report to the maintainer hub's POST /api/feedback/forward. It sends the collector's token and its own origin key, from an outbox (data/feedback-outbox.json, ≤ 200 reports, retried 1 min … 1 h — a target with no feedback door pauses it, below) that survives a restart.
  - **On the hub:** the report sits beside the hub's own with its origin (a chip on the sheet, `origin` in feedback.list), its words stored through the peer-text belt.
  - **The mark-back:** a mark on a forwarded report (the owner's or feedback.handled) goes BACK by a pull. The origin asks GET /api/feedback/forward/marks at boot and every 6 h, and its agent's `vibespace-feedback list` then says «handled in 2.369.NNN».
  - **The backfill:** the first time an instance has a target, the OPEN reports already on file are forwarded too, once.
  - **A target with no feedback door** (lane feedback-forward-404, 2.369.338 — the fleet's target is the cluster's telemetry collector): a 404 / 405 / 501 from the forward or the marks door PAUSES the outbox for that target. Nothing is sent until the same time the next day (ONE re-probe), or at once when the target URL or the release it answers (`X-VibeSpace-Version`, read off the telemetry forward's answers too) changes. The reports stay queued (≤ 200, the oldest dropped by id) and go when the door appears. Said once: the log line «feedback forward paused: <target> has no feedback door (404) — re-probed daily; N records waiting», and ONE low For-you notice only when a person set telemetry.forwardUrl on that instance (a cluster-env target logs only). `vibespace-feedback list` says «forward paused: the target has no door» beside the unsent reports (and «not forwarded: the outbox was full» for a dropped one).
  - No target ⇒ nothing leaves the instance.
- **The maintainers mark a fleet instance's reports** (lane fleet-feedback-marks, 2.369.346 — the owner's option B: fleet feedback is READ from the cluster side, and the maintainers had no door to mark it): an instance started with env `VIBESPACE_MAINTAINER_KEY_SHA` (the chart's `maintainerKeySha` — the sha256 of the cluster's maintainer key, never the key) accepts that key for `feedback.list` and `feedback.handled` only.
