On the pod's shell: `env VIBESPACE_MAINTAINER_KEY=… vibespace-feedback list --open` / `vibespace-feedback handled fb-… --version 2.369.NNN [--note "…"]`. The row then says «handled in 2.369.NNN by the maintainers» with the note; the audit line «marked handled by the maintainer key · 2.369.NNN».
- **The one who filed it is told** (same lane): a mark that names a release — the hub's feedback.handled, an instance's maintainer key, the forward's mark-back — reaches the filing conversation at its next turn as ONE free line, «Your feedback report fb-… (about …) was handled in 2.369.NNN: <note>», the same words whichever road marked it.

### Vault — the second password (lane vault-e2e-password, 2026-10-19; the owner after a leaked-credential incident: every stored secret sealed under one vault key that only a SECOND password opens, no auto-unlock, the first sign-in after a restart unlocks it, the unlocked state in memory only)
Every credential VibeSpace stores — API keys and tokens (accounts), mount secrets, channel tokens, integration keys, a desktop app's stored logins, browser passkeys — is encrypted under a store key, and every store key is now held in ONE vault (data/vault.json) whose key only the owner's second password unwraps. After every start the vault is LOCKED; the first page load behind the sign-in shows 「解锁保险库」 (a phone gets the same modal). Until then anything that needs a stored credential says 「保险库已锁定——先解锁」 and the taskbar shows a lock chip that opens the modal; nothing is read and nothing new is made. 「稍后」 closes the modal; the chip stays.
- **After a restart, every page says so — not only a freshly loaded one** (lane vault-relock-door, the owner 2026-10-20 「为啥我有的时候更新后需要重新输入二次密码有时候不用」): the vault locks at every restart, but only a page LOAD used to open the unlock dialog — a restart that KEPT the bundle (a crash, a same-build `systemctl restart`, the `Restart=always` respawn) reconnected an already-open tab WITHOUT a reload, so it sat on its stale unlocked view while device links, the relay and account switches waited in silence. Now: (1) an open tab RE-ASKS for the second password on the ws reconnect — the vault's facts carry a `startedAt` (the server's boot), and a NEW startedAt (a restart) opens the dialog ONCE, while a mere reconnect to the same process or a lock ACT from another device (the same startedAt) draws only the chip, never a second dialog; (2) a PERSISTENT strip sits at the top of every page (and the phone) while the vault is locked — 「保险库未解锁 — 设备链接、中继和账号切换在等」 with a 「解锁…」 button, below the maintenance banner when both show, NOT dismissable (only the dialog's 「稍后」 closes the dialog); (3) the For-you tray files ONE notice at boot when the vault is set up and locked — 「保险库在重启后已锁定…」, its click opens the unlock dialog, a person's unlock on any device clears it, and a second restart while still locked never files a duplicate (a vault that is not set up files nothing). The lock LAW is unchanged — the DEK is still zeroed on shutdown and there is still no auto-unlock; only the ASK changed.
- **Said at once, never first at a refusal** (lane vault-locked-loud, 2.369.332 — the owner 2026-10-20 「如果 vault 没解锁应该直接在界面上有个显著提醒，不需要等到 agent 被 block 了。比如应该在刷新后第一时间弹对话框，或者在 inbox 有个 urgent 提醒，或者直接设置按钮标红标」): while the vault is SET UP and LOCKED, three things say so, all from ONE PURE table (src/vault-loud.js `vaultLoudState`, asked by src/lib/vault-unlock.js and src/server/vault-hooks.js). (1) THE DIALOG opens at a page load and at a reconnect — once per LOCK in a tab: 「稍后」, Esc or ✕ set that lock aside (sessionStorage `vs-vault-unlock-later` = `startedAt:lockedSince`), so a reload asks no more while a restart or a new lock asks again; a lock act seen live by an open page (the idle lock on a hub without a sign-in) draws the marks, never a dialog over the page. (2) THE ⚙ BUTTON — the toolbar's and the phone nav's — turns red with a lock badge and says «Vault locked — click to unlock»; a press opens the unlock dialog first, then the menu. (3) THE FOR-YOU TRAY holds ONE URGENT item (an action row: the red badge counts it and its arrival toasts — the earlier restart notice above was a grey notice) filed the MOMENT the vault locks — a boot over a locked vault, a lock act, the idle lock: «The vault is locked — agents that need a credential will be refused until you unlock it. Enter the second password to unlock.»; a later refusal names who on the same row (the bullet below the next); its door opens the unlock dialog; the unlock resolves it on every client and the next lock files it again. A hub that never set up a vault shows none of the three.
- **The lock chip sits beside For-you, wherever Customize put it** (lane vault-chip-zone-errors, 2.369.339 — inc-mvi50qdh-ygmh: the owner's For-you button lives in the toolbar's second row, the taskbar tray is empty): the chip (and the phone nav's) goes right before the For-you button in that button's own zone (customize-mode.js `slotBeside`), else at the taskbar tray's end, and follows it whenever the arrangement changes. Before, it inserted into the tray before a For-you button that was not there — it threw at every start, and the throw took the unlock dialog, the strip and the ⚙ mark with it; each lock sign now draws on its own. Filling the second password from the browser's saved passwords (a keydown with no key) is recorded as `(fill)`, never an error.
- **Setting it up**: on an instance that has no vault yet, the page asks at every load (on a new instance right after the welcome tour) — 「设置第二密码」, twice, at least 8 characters, not the sign-in password, with the plain warning that a forgotten second password means the stored credentials are gone (an export of them is not part of this version). Setting it moves every existing key file into the vault (each file replaced by a `.sealed` marker, the key overwritten and removed) — any failure puts everything back.
- **⚙ System ▸ Vault… — the one door** (lane vault-one-door, the owner 2026-10-19: 「这个没必要分成两个按钮吧」): ONE row opens the Vault window; its header holds the state (since when, set up when) and the doors by state — 「设置第二密码…」 (not set up), 「解锁…」 (locked; the same unlock modal), 「立即锁定」 (unlocked), 「修改第二密码…」 (locked or unlocked) — and 「闲置后锁定」 (never by default; 1 / 4 / 8 / 24 h without a keyboard or pointer on any VibeSpace page). Locked, the list says so (v2, design q-047 §3.5: with its own 「解锁…」 beside the header's); the search bar appears once it is unlocked. The door every locked card offers (「保险库已锁定——先解锁」) still opens the unlock modal; once unlocked it opens this window.
- **Agents** see the state and may lock it (`vibespace-vault status|lock`); unlocking, setting up and changing are a person's, from the page. Five wrong passwords in a row pause the vault for a minute; every failure is recorded with its address (never the password) in data/vault-audit.jsonl.
- **Agents put their OWN secrets in — `mint` and `put`** (design q-043 §9, lane vault-mint-put, the owner 2026-10-19 「保险库给 agent 一条『存放 + 随机密码』指令…agent 看不到密码也能完成任务」): an agent may CREATE (never read) entries in its own namespace `agent:<its conversation>/<name>` — `vibespace-vault mint <name>` has the HUB generate a random value and seal it (the agent gets only the entry name + a `vault://` reference, NEVER the value — for registering an account, setting a service password, making a token), and `vibespace-vault put <name> --from-file <0600 file> | --stdin` seals a value the agent already has (NEVER on the command line — argv is readable). Creating needs no approval from the owner (it costs nothing and leaks nothing); the agent picks only the short `<name>` (the conversation scope is added for it, so it can never write into another conversation's namespace). The Vault window shows each with a provenance chip — 「agent 铸造 · 从未显示」 (minted) or 「agent 存入 · agent 见过明文」 (stored, with a rotate hint, since the transcript's copy is unprotected). The owner reveals a value behind 「验证是你」 like any other entry; an agent can NEVER read one back (use — filling a form, running a command — is a later lane). A locked vault refuses both by name (`vault_locked`); every mint/put is audited by name + actor, never the value.
- **A refusal while locked tells YOU, not the agent** (lane vault-locked-refusal-notice, the owner 2026-10-20 「为啥老是有 agent 和我说需要解锁 vault，这个不是应该系统检测到 agent 被阻拦了然后提醒我解锁吗」): every door that refuses `vault_locked` notes WHO it stopped and WHAT — a conversation by its name (an automation verb, its link to a machine), a machine's device link, a channel account's sign-in, the relay, VibeSpace's own store reads — through the vault's one helper (src/server/vault-engine.js `blocked`; the list is src/vault-blocked.js: per lock epoch, ≤ 50 callers, the rest a count, cleared at the unlock). The restart's For-you notice is THE item: filed at boot over a set-up + locked vault AND refreshed whenever the list changes — 「保险库未解锁 — 在等它的：«Lane X» (vibespace-api conversations.rename) · «mac-mini» (device link) · …」, one detail line per caller; a lock act files it at the first refusal; one row ever (a later lock reopens the same row); dismissing it holds until the next lock; the unlock resolves it. The persistent strip says 「{n} 项在等它」. The agent is told the user already knows — every agent-facing `vault_locked` sentence, vibespace-vault's LOCKED line and the manuals say "the user has already been told … do not ask them to unlock it or for its password: wait, or do other work" (src/vault-blocked.js `agentWords`); the code stays `vault_locked`. The lock law is unchanged: a note never reads a key or unlocks.
- **The vault never hands an agent a secret's value** (lane vault-use-law, design q-043 D1 — the owner 2026-10-20: there is no `vibespace-vault get`): an agent — and a background job, and an automation key — gets a PURPOSE (VibeSpace uses the credential for it: a channel send, the relay, a device link …) and a RECEIPT, never the value; only you see values, in the Vault window behind 验证是你. Every use by an agent is one line in data/vault-audit.jsonl (which entry, for what, which conversation, through which door, the outcome — never the value). **Repeated failed uses reach your For you tray**: when one conversation (or job) is refused the same entry 20 times in a day — knocking on the unlock door with its token, asking for a link token it has none of — ONE item names it and the entry; you mark it done (an unlock does not), and it can come back a day later. Twenty wrong second passwords from one address in a day file an urgent item naming the address. (The one place an agent-side process receives a value is a remote conversation's own connection to its own machine, held in memory.)
- **A restart waits for its person**: a pod or a hub that restarts comes back locked; credentials a cluster preset injects keep working once stored, sealed like the rest.
- **The Vault window — what it holds** (lane vault-contents-window, the owner 2026-10-19: 「类似 google password manager，需要输入密码才能查看一段时间」): ⚙ System ▸ Vault… (or the sidebar's System panel line 「查看内容…」) lists every stored credential by store — accounts' API keys and long-lived tokens, integration keys (a paired machine's too), channel sign-ins, custom client secrets and webhook caller secrets, storage secrets, apps' stored logins, passkeys — each masked (`••••••••`), with its kind (an account's `claude setup-token` says 「长期 OAuth 令牌」 / Long-lived OAuth token and «setup-token» — lane vault-one-door; a mount's or a channel's OAuth sign-in says 「OAuth 令牌」), a length class (short / medium / long), when it was saved and when its store key was last used. Search and sort; a 「技术细节」 fold per row holds the raw reference.
  - 「显示」 (or 「全部显示」) asks for the second password again — 「验证是你」; then every value can be shown ON THIS PAGE for 5 minutes (a countdown chip; fixed — using it does not extend it). Each 「显示」 opens ONE value into its row's field; 「隐藏」 forgets it; 「复制」 copies it and clears the clipboard after 30 s while the tab stays open. At 5:00, at a lock (anywhere: another tab, an agent, the idle lock) or when the window closes, every value is hidden again and the next 「显示」 asks again. Another tab, a reload or another browser asks again (the window belongs to the page).
  - The same window guards the other places a stored credential could be read (r2): Manage Agents' 「Show key…」 asks 「验证是你」 first; a storage connection's edit dialog shows its saved secrets as dots (unchanged unless a new one is typed) with 「显示」 to see them; exporting the configuration WITH credentials asks for the second password. An instance whose vault is not set up keeps the old behaviour (there is no second password to ask).
  - Every value shown is recorded (data/vault-audit.jsonl `vault-reveal`: who, address, which entry — never the value); 20 a minute at most. Agents cannot list or show anything here.
  - The doors per row are the store's own: 「删除」 runs the store's delete with its card's confirm (remove the account / its token, remove the mount, clear an integration's keys, remove the channel account, delete the passkey, forget an app's logins); 「换新…」 opens the re-authorize door (integrations, channel accounts).
- **An agent runs a command with a stored secret it never sees — `vibespace-vault run`** (lanes vault-run-model + vault-run-door, design q-043 §8, 2.369.329; the owner 2026-10-19 「agent 要用敏感信息执行指令——vault 提供指令 proxy」): the agent writes a reference (`vault://<store>/<row>/<field>`; `vibespace-vault list` names the ones it may use) and the HUB starts the command with the value given as an env variable, a 0600 file (shredded at the end) or stdin — never on the command line — and answers its output with the value and its encoded forms blanked to `[vault:…]` — every spelling a real tool prints by itself (lane vault-scrub-forms, 2.369.331: base64, base32, URL, JSON, hex, UTF-16, quoted-printable, backslash-escaped, HTML entities, coloured or wrapped), one window over both stdout and stderr; scrubbing is a best-effort belt, not a promise — a command that re-encodes the value can still show it, so the card and the manual say the owner reads the whole command before it runs, and a part of a value (or one under 8 bytes) is never blanked. The owner opens each storage secret or app login for runs in the Vault window («Usable by agent runs», off by default; turning it on asks 验证是你); a login, pairing, channel or passkey entry never. Each new command SHAPE (the tool, its flags, the hosts, the secrets — file names may vary) asks the owner on an urgent For-you card — 允许一次 / 此形状总是 / 拒绝: a cluster instance asks every run, a local one asks a new shape once (until the vault locks); «此形状总是» (30 days) asks for the second password again and is not offered for a shell, an interpreter or a tool whose destination is unknown. Tools that print, transform, pack or copy what they read are refused by name. A lock stops every running command — and whatever it left behind, in its group or not (the agent gets `vault_locked`); a run that ends takes its stray processes with it. The card names the program that will run, and says so when an agent could have written it (no «always» then). Every run is one audit line (data/vault-audit.jsonl `vault-run`: who, the command, the secrets, the exit, the bytes blanked — never a value). What it is NOT (said on the card's door and in the manual): the command runs under the agent's own user (it could read the value while the command runs — hygiene and an audit, not isolation), a tool may send the value to a host the card showed, and the blanking is a sieve — a value written to a file and read back by the agent never meets it.
- **An agent asks for a stored secret with its purpose — `vibespace-vault request` / `uses`; a lock ends everything open** (lane vault-manual-and-lock, design q-043 D3 ⑤ + D4, 2.369.331): an agent whose entry is closed for runs asks ONCE — `vibespace-vault request <vault://…> --for "<purpose>"` files one For-you question «<conversation> asks to use a stored secret» naming the entry and the purpose (it waits for nobody and never expires; a second for the same entry while one is open is refused `request_pending`). The owner answers **Allow once** (its next run with it, within 8 hours) / **For 8 hours** — both ask for the second password, as opening the row does — / **Deny** (a click; the same entry is not asked again for 10 minutes) — a grant opens that entry for THAT conversation the way «Usable by agent runs» opens it for every one; each new command shape still shows its run card. `vibespace-vault uses` prints the conversation's grants, its waiting requests and its own uses (entry, purpose, when, door, outcome, receipt — the run's receipt is one `vr-…` on the answer, the run's line and each entry's use line). **A lock** (the owner, an agent's `lock`, the idle timer — never the shutdown) **ends at once**: the Vault window's value window, every waiting ask (run cards, requests, held automation calls — withdrawn `vault_locked`), every one-time grant (requests' grants, unspent automation «once») and every running `vault run`. **Every sentence about a locked vault** says the owner has been told and where to unlock it — for a person «(Unlock… at the top of the page; For you names what is waiting on it)», for an agent «a person unlocks it on this instance's page; the user has already been told» (test-vault-words: 62 sites, each a row). The agent manual (docs/agent/vault-manual.md, index-only) is rewritten around what an agent CAN do and never gets.
- **An agent asks you to PASTE a secret it does not have — a masked box in For you** (lane vault-paste-request, 2.369.346 — the owner 2026-10-23: 「应该允许你给我弹一个保险库输入框让我直接 paste 进去，省得我还得手动去保险库搞」): `vibespace-vault request "<what, in your words>" --purpose "<why>" [--into <row>.<field> | --kind api-key|password|secret] [--name <label>]` files ONE For-you item — «<conversation> asks you for a secret: <what>» over what it is for and WHERE the value goes (an Integrations card's secret field such as `llm.apiKey`, or a new vault entry with its label) — with a MASKED field (a password field: a phone keyboard's paste works, nothing autocompletes, no password manager offers or keeps it), 「存入保险库」 and 「拒绝」; no reply box (a reply goes into the chat, where a secret must never land). The value rides the press's POST body to the owner's cookie door only and goes straight to its ONE writer: a field ⇒ the integration store (trimmed, the field's own rule — a refusal says the rule in the box, never the value), a new entry ⇒ the vault's `secret:<id>` with its label, kind and a note naming who asked and why. The item then resolves itself («saved to the vault») and the asking conversation reads a receipt at its next turn: STORED, where (`llm.apiKey`, or the entry's `vault://secrets/secret:<id>/secret` — which that conversation may use in `vibespace-vault run` for 8 hours: the paste is the grant), the purpose — never the value; 「拒绝」 (or ✕ / ✓ without a paste) ⇒ REFUSED, and the same place is quiet for 10 minutes. The box is kept across every repaint (a broadcast never takes what you pasted or the focus); a LOCKED vault is said in the box by name (vault_locked) with 「解锁…」 inline; a lock act withdraws every open request (the agent is told to ask again once unlocked) while a request kept over a restart waits. The For-you window and the Vault window's 「需要你」 open the same box as a dialog (「粘贴存入…」). Bounds: 4 open per conversation, 64 on the hub.
- **「其他密钥或密码…」 — a secret no card holds** (lane vault-paste-request ⑥ — the owner in 「＋ 添加…」: 「我压根没法添加啊」): the Vault window's 添加… lists it after the stores' own doors; its dialog takes a name, a kind (password · API key · secret), the value (the same masked field) and a note, and saves a free entry `secret:<id>` — listed under «Passwords & keys» (密码与密钥) with its kind chip and «By you», 「显示」 behind 验证是你, 「删除」 through the usual confirm. An agent uses one by purpose (a run by reference, once the row's switch is on or it was granted) and never reads it; `vibespace-vault list` names it by label and reference only. A hub's vault never reaches a pod: the fleet's presets (cluster Secrets) are not edited from here, and a paste into an Integrations field sets that hub's OWN value (which outranks a cluster default on that hub only).
- **Automation keys** live in the vault too (design q-046 — the «Automation keys» section below): their values are vault entries, listed in the Vault window under «自动化 key», shown only behind 验证是你 and only to hand to an outside party.
- **The Vault window v2 — grouped by what each secret is FOR** (lane vault-window-v2, 2.369.328 — design q-047 §3, the owner 2026-10-19 「鉴于要支持的种类越来越复杂，建议重新设计一下 vault 界面的 UI」, decision ④: the nine purposes, the store named under 技术细节). Default size 980×680, one window.
  - **The rail** (left; a phone or a window narrower than 640 px: a chip strip at the top): 全部 + 两步验证 · 登录与账号 · 集成与频道 · 机器与中继 · 存储 · 应用登录 · 通行密钥 · 自动化 key · 网站登录 (lane browser-login: the `web-login:` entries — a website's login the custom kernel fills; «user · site», where it came from: by you · registered by an agent through the vault · typed by an agent itself; 用于… = this account / any account on this site / any site) · 密码与密钥 (lane vault-paste-request: the free `secret:` entries) · agent 存放 (+ 其它 only when something lands there), each with its count — the count of rows the list shows for it under the current search and filters. A purpose picked shows its rows only (an empty one says 「Nothing stored here」, with its own doors — 自动化 key's 铸造…). ONE row ⇒ ONE purpose, PURE `purposeOf` (src/vault-inventory.js) = its KIND FAMILY's category in the kind registry (src/vault-kinds.js, lane vault-totp-add — the rail's categories and 添加…'s order read it too): an `agent:` entry → agent 存放 first; accounts → 登录与账号; an integration's per-machine row (`<row>/<host>`) and the hub's `host:` / `frp:` entries → 机器与中继; the other integrations + every channel → 集成与频道; mounts → 存储; app logins → 应用登录; passkeys → 通行密钥; automation keys (`apikey:`) → 自动化 key; a two-step entry (`totp:`, lane vault-totp) → 两步验证; anything else (a sealed file's key) → 其它.
  - **The bar**: search (names, kinds, purposes, where it came from — in the page's language too) · 排序 (最近使用 by default · 名称 · 类型 · 最新) · 出处 (我自己 / agent 铸造 / agent 见过明文 / 系统 — several at once; none = all) · 只看可显示 · 「添加…」 (the stores' own add doors: an account, an integration key, a channel account, an automation key; lane vault-totp adds 两步验证… through `registerVaultAdd`). Nothing of the view is kept: every open starts at 全部. On a phone the filters sit behind one 「筛选…」 (a dialog; each press applies at once).
  - **A row** = name + meta (detail · kind · length class · saved) · the KIND chip · the PROVENANCE chip (PURE `provenanceOf` — 我自己 · 扫码 · 我自己 · hub 铸造 · 从未显示 · agent 铸造 · 从未显示 · agent 存入 · agent 见过明文 · 系统 · 永不显示; its help says where the value came from) · a STATE chip when one holds (「N 天后到期」 within 3 days of an account's long-lived token's end, 「已过期」, 「建议轮换」 when an agent stored a value it saw) · the last use · the value and its doors BY KIND (no door is greyed — a door a row has not is not drawn; a never-shown row has no 显示; a two-step row draws its code through lane vault-totp's door, 「看码」) · 技术细节 (store · entry · field).
  - **A reveal's reason is the door's own help** (the owner 2026-10-20: 「只为交给外界」 beside an automation key's value read as the key's STATE): every 「显示」 says why in its tooltip — an automation key's: 「显示密钥值——只在要交给外部系统时；内部 agent 按授权使用，不需要看到值」; nothing sits beside a value as if it were its state.
  - **「需要你」** at the top = the For-you tray's OWN open items of origin `vault` (at most 5, urgent first; the same items, the same answers — answered here they leave the tray, answered in the tray they leave the band): the held automation call (允许一次 · 一直 · 拒绝), the restart's unlock notice (解锁…), and two new notices — **使用失败** (an agent's use of a key refused because the vault was locked, it was not granted, or a grant / card expired: ONE per key per hour, counted while it is open; answered inside the hour it is not re-filed) with 打开行 · 知道了, and **建议轮换** (an agent stored a value it had seen — filed by the store act that does it, q-043 §9's put; once answered it never comes back by itself) with 换新… · 知道了. In the tray their body opens the Vault window on their row.
  - **Locked**: the rail lists the purposes with «—», the list says it is locked with 「解锁…」 — and there is NO 「添加…」 (locked = read-only; the bar is away, nothing greyed). Keyed: a row element lives while its row's facts do — a search, a filter, a sort or a refresh moves it, an open value stays in it.
- **Every vault wait is said** (lane vault-slow-load, the owner 2026-10-22 «保险库操作好像加载时间有点长»): from the press to the answer, a vault act shows a spinner and the step's name and never a blank second. 解锁's button is disabled and says 「正在解锁…」 while the second password is checked (its KDF, ~0.5 s). Setup says 「正在设置…」, 修改 「正在修改…」, 验证是你 「正在验证…」, the Vault window's list 「正在读取保险库…」 until its first answer, 显示全部 「正在显示 n / N…」, 审计… 「正在读取审计记录…」. The window asks the list and the automation keys' grants together, so it waits once. A vault door slower than 250 ms logs one line (`[vault] POST /api/vault/unlock answered in 602 ms`: the route's pattern, never a value), and an incident snapshot carries the filing page's last 20 requests (route + ms). Filing an incident never stops the hub: the scene's freeze (the transcripts' tails and hashes, the metas) runs in its own worker, and the canary's «a blocked loop» line names what held the loop (call · bytes · file · the src/ frame) or says it was CPU work.
- **Two-step codes (TOTP)** (design q-047 L1, lane vault-totp — the owner 2026-10-19 「哦还有个 TOTP 也可以支持一下」; decisions ①② 2026-10-20 with ①'s amendment): the vault keeps a site's two-step seed as its own entry `totp:<name>` (listed under «Hub secrets» by name, kind 「两步验证码」). While the vault is unlocked, 「看码」 shows the CURRENT code (3 + 3 digits), a ring and the seconds left — no 「验证是你」: a code dies in 30 seconds, the seed is the secret — and asks for the next one at the boundary while the page is visible; 「复制」 copies it (cleared after 30 s). Every view is recorded (`vault-totp-view`), 20 a minute at most. The SEED and its settings show only through the row's 「显示」 — the second password again, one value: the otpauth link, which any authenticator imports — recorded as a reveal, never in a list, never to an agent. 「用于…」 lets a running conversation (THIS run of it: a conversation that ended and came back is asked for again) or a Task Group have the CODE — `vibespace-vault totp <name>` answers the code and its seconds left, never the seed; locked ⇒ refused; every answer recorded (`vault-totp-use`). 「删除」 takes its grants with it. Adding (lane vault-totp-add, 2.369.359 — the owner 2026-10-26 「我似乎不能添加两步验证在vault里」): 添加… ▸ 两步验证… opens ONE dialog with two ways — 「粘贴 otpauth 链接」 (the link's issuer, account and settings shown as facts, the name taken from them until you type one) or 「输入密钥」 (the seed — spaces and lower case are fine — a name, and 6 / 8 digits · 30 / 60 s · SHA1 / SHA256 / SHA512 under 「高级」, the standard's defaults); 「预览」 shows the code the seed makes NOW (the hub's `POST /api/vault/totp` preview — nothing stored) with its ring and seconds, to compare with the authenticator (the next code at each step while the page is visible, ten times — 「预览」 again restarts them), and 「保存」 appears only after it (and goes again at any change); a click on 「预览」 or 「保存」 while a preview is still on its way waits for it, its button saying so (正在预览… / 正在保存…) — never nothing; every refusal says its words in the dialog (not an otpauth link, a counter-based link, a seed that is not base32, no name, a name taken, locked ⇒ 「解锁…」 first); the link and seed fields are masked (显示 toggles them) and wiped at every close. 「网站登录…」's two-step field lists the vault's codes. The door is the kind registry's `add` surface for totp (src/vault-kinds.js — a kind family is ONE registry row + scripts/test-vault-kinds-census.mjs). A QR image is not read yet: no decoder ships (design q-047 §2.5, L3 — a dependency is the owner's call).
- **A secret in an agent's OWN output is blanked where it is written** (lane agent-output-sinks, design q-043 D3 ②③): the five stores that keep an agent's own text — a task progress note, a vibespace-ask For-you detail, a session-status notice, a message to a group (and its held stash), a background job's log — pass it through THE ONE BELT (src/agent-output-belt.js) BEFORE it lands. A live vault value an agent happened to echo (a run-referable or agent-minted entry — never a `host:`/`file:` token the vault never shows) and its base64/url/JSON/hex forms become `[vault:<entry>]`; a secret SHAPE (a bearer, a key prefix, a PEM block) becomes «redacted», its name kept. So a reader of the owner's For-you tray, a peer in a group, or anyone with the disk never sees a credential the agent printed. Masked at the write, so locking the vault never has to scrub what already landed.

### Automation keys — VibeSpace's own API keys (design q-046 L1, lane automation-keys-core, 2.369.319; the owner 2026-10-19: "给 vibespace 本身开发个 API … 专门的 key 授权，存在 vault 里，内部 agent 可以被单项授权这个 key，全程不需要我看到 key")
VibeSpace's own automation API (the dispatcher's first need: rename a worker's conversation; open / status / bind / end / invite wired by lane automation-verbs, L2 — the bullet below). A **key** is minted by the hub in the Vault window (⚙ System ▸ Vault contents… ▸ «自动化 key» ▸ 铸造…: a name + the verbs it may do — the closed table) and its value is sealed at once as the vault entry `apikey:<id>` (data/automation-keys.json keeps its sha256 and the grants, never the value). A person **grants** a key to a conversation or a Task Group (授权给…, a multi-select picker; a chip's ✕ takes one back). A conversation then calls a verb with its OWN session token (`vibespace-api call conversations.rename --name …`) — the hub judges the grant × the verb × the vault, runs it and writes ONE audit line (data/automation-audit.jsonl: names and ids, never a text body); the key's row says when it was last used.
- **No grant yet**: the call files ONE urgent For-you card per key × conversation × VERB (origin Vault; q-048 verify M3 — a joined verb rode the first one's card, and an Always for a rename released a waiting billed open): 允许一次 (this call) / 一直（授权给这个会话） (a grant the window lists) / 拒绝 (quiet for 10 minutes, that verb); 60 s without an answer refuses it; the card closed any other way refuses it; each answer releases only its own card. The call waits for the answer — and a caller that goes away meanwhile (its request closed: the CLI killed, the turn stopped) is WITHDRAWN (q-048 verify M1): `caller_gone` in the audit, its last waiter gone closes the card, and an answer after that runs nothing (`ask_settled`).
- **The vault locked** ⇒ every use answers 423 `vault_locked` (the CLI exits 3), a call waiting on a card too; nothing is cached across a lock; the unlock resumes everything. The refusal notes the conversation by name and the verb (the Vault's For-you item lists it — lane vault-locked-refusal-notice), and its words tell the agent the user was already told: it never asks them to unlock.
- **显示** reveals a key's value (one per reveal, the 5-minute window behind 验证是你, audited `vault-reveal`) — the row says it is ONLY to hand to an outside party (the outside door, Bearer vsak_, is L3).
- **撤销** drops the value from the vault and every grant; the audit keeps what the key did.
- An agent never sees a value: no CLI verb, no agent route and no answer carries one (test-vault-law ⑦); an agent never writes a grant (the owner doors refuse every bearer `human_only`).
- **Limits (lane automation-open-limits, 2.369.324 — the q-048 verify's M2):** a key that opens conversations says what they may use — **folders** (picked in the hub's file tree; a folder counts by its real path, so `..` and a link out are outside), **accounts** (any, or the ones picked — an open naming none is judged by the default account it would bill), **permission modes** (from the harness tables; `default` = no flag — the CLI's own setting, which the hub RESOLVES at the open (lane automation-open-permission-resolve, q-049 M2): the folder's own three-layer settings (`permissions.defaultMode`, `disableBypassPermissionsMode`; src/server/permission-rules.js resolveDefaultMode, PURE claudeDefaultMode) read AFTER the folder judge, and the resolved mode must be in the key's list — else `permission_not_allowed` naming it and the layer («the CLI's own setting (project, <file>) is bypassPermissions; this key allows default»); the picker's row says 「CLI 自己的设置（现在是 X）」 (边界…: the key's first folder; 铸造…: the hub's own); bypassPermissions only when ticked), **models** (any, or chips), **modes** (chat; terminal only when ticked). Picked in 铸造… (shown while 开一个对话 is ticked; a fresh key has no folder and no account until the owner picks), edited with 边界…. Judged on the hub after the grant and BEFORE the spend ceiling and the spawn: outside ⇒ refused by name (`cwd_outside_roots` · `account_not_allowed` · `permission_not_allowed` · `model_not_allowed` · `mode_not_allowed`), audited, nothing charged, no first-use card; `vibespace-api` prints the key's limits. A key minted before limits (or with a damaged record) reads as a fresh key — no folders — so it refuses every open and shows 「Limits not set」／「未设边界」 until the owner's 边界… sets them (q-049 M1: fail closed, never unbounded; a missing field never widens a key). 审计… lists a key's audit lines (a refused open with its code).
- **编辑… (lane key-folder-picker-all, 2.369.333 — the owner 2026-10-21: 「我之前授权给你的 key 似乎没法改变"能做什么"」 and 「这个不能选"所有路径"嘛？或者至少"所有子文件夹"吧。」):** every key's row has 编辑… — the mint's verb checkboxes (its own ticked, a verb a later release added unticked) and, while 开一个对话 is ticked, its limits — saved through the mint's own rules and store write (the value and the grants never change; audited `key.scopes` «scopes changed by the owner: +… -…»); a verb added rides the key's existing grants (a grant is per key × conversation — no new card), a verb removed is refused from the next call by name (`verb_not_in_scope`, the keys named, with or without `--key`); the folders offer 「所有路径」 (exactly `['/']`, red, «any folder on this VibeSpace, including your home» — the row, the card, the CLI say all paths) or 「只有这些文件夹（含子文件夹）」, and a folder is shown «及子文件夹» — a root always covered its subfolders; an opening key with no folder is still refused.
- **The feedback verbs (lane feedback-handled-verb):** `feedback.handled` (`id` fb-…, `version` the release that shipped the fix, `note` ≤ 200 optional — the owner's Mark handled through the same feedback-store call, by the calling conversation's name) · `feedback.list` (a read: the open reports with their ids; another agent's words leave through the peer-text belt). The first use asks once, like every verb (its Always grants the key, so the other verb asks nothing); a key without the verb is refused `verb_not_in_scope`; the audit keeps the id and the release, never the note.
- **The maintainer key (lane fleet-feedback-marks):** not a key of this table — an instance's env `VIBESPACE_MAINTAINER_KEY_SHA` names it by its sha256; the `vsmk_` bearer on `POST /api/agent/automation/:verb` runs `feedback.list` / `feedback.handled` only (any other verb or door ⇒ `maintainer_key_scope`; an unknown key ⇒ `maintainer_key_unknown`), with no grant, no card and no vault entry; audited as subject `maintainer`.
- **The conversation verbs (lane automation-verbs, L2):** `conversations.open` (billed — the spend ceiling decides BEFORE the spawn, charged to the key; the owner's own create path against a headless socket; it waits ≤ 20 s for the conversation id, else `pending`; `--name` names the worker AT its create — the frame's `sessionName`, what ws-create reads (B-dbba: as `name` it was ignored until a rename), and its first-use card says what it would open: the name and the folder) · `conversations.status` (a read) · `.rename` · `.bind` (into a Task Group the caller is in) · `.end` · `groups.invite` (quiet — no wake) — all through src/server/conversation-ops.js's seams (the owner's ws frames and routes call the same ones, byte-identical). A conversation the key OPENED is within its reach — PERSISTED (the key store's `opened` rows, written at the open; lane conversations-archive-verb: a Map in memory lost them at the .331 restart and the owner's key could not end its own workers) — any other needs a grant: ONE PURE rule, src/automation-keys.js `reachVerdict` (the opener / a grant to the conversation or one of its Task Groups / the caller itself — or the grant's REACH, the bullet below), the same for status · rename · bind · end · archive · invite. `vibespace-api conversations …` / `groups invite` print the answer as JSON. Gates: test-conversation-ops (fast), test-automation-verbs (heavy, the coordinator's road on a real hub).
- **Archive (lane conversations-archive-verb — the owner 2026-10-20: 「这些不用 archive 吗」 about finished lane conversations):** `conversations.archive {target, force?, resolveAsks?}` ends the conversation if it is still live, then archives it exactly as the sidebar's 归档 does (the same archived-list write, broadcast to every client — the owner's sidebar no longer shows it); a running turn ⇒ `subject_busy` unless force; the conversation's open For-you asks ⇒ `asks_open` naming them unless resolveAsks dismisses them first (never archive a worker with open asks); an ended conversation is archived by its id; already archived ⇒ `already_archived`. `vibespace-api conversations archive <target> [--force] [--resolve-asks]`.
- **A key's failure notice** (使用失败 — For you and the Vault window's 「需要你」; lane vault-key-row-compact, the card grammar: actor + verb + named object) — its HEAD says who used which key for what: «<who> 用 key「<key>」做「<verb>」被拒» (the verb in the closed table's own words — the item keeps it as a param that IS words, `{key}`, so the page says it in its language); its SECOND line is the cause with the door, the conversation named in it (the grant reaches only what the key opened — widen the reach on the key's row / the key is not granted to that conversation / the vault is locked — Unlock… / the key does not hold that verb — add it with 编辑… …); the hour's count, the last target and the last caller sit under ONE closed 详情 fold; 打开行 / 知道了 stay. One item per key × verb × reason per hour (its English sentence = the head + the cause). A use refused before a key was picked says «<who> 用自动化 key 做「<verb>」被拒» with its own cause. The band is bounded (it scrolls past ~four notices), so the list below keeps its room on a phone.
- **A grant's reach (lane key-instance-scope — the owner 2026-10-20: 「key 应该可以被授权在整个 vibe space 上工作」):** every grant says how far the key reaches BEYOND what it opened, what a grant names and the caller itself — 「只有它开的会话」 (the default, the narrowest: nothing more), 「这些岗位的会话」 (the conversations of the caller's Task Groups — the card names them; the Vault window lets the owner pick the groups) or 「整个 VibeSpace」 (every conversation of this instance, present and later — RED-tinted, its title says it reaches the owner's own conversations too). Chosen on the first-use card beside 允许一次 / 一直 (the tray and the For-you window), shown as a chip on each 授权给 chip of the key's row and changed there (the reach dialog — the same store write the card makes), picked in 授权给… for the grants it adds. ONE more row of PURE `reachVerdict`'s table (a mutant that lets 整个 VibeSpace through for a 只有它开的会话 grant is RED); a caller holding the key by two roads acts by the wider. What instance reach may still NOT do: the verbs' own refusals stay — a running turn (`subject_busy` unless force), open For-you asks (`asks_open` unless resolveAsks), an archived conversation (`already_archived`); there is no further fence — the owner chose it. `vibespace-api keys` prints each key's reach; a target outside it answers `not_granted` naming the reach and the door (the key's row in the Vault window), and the 使用失败 notice says the same. A missing reach reads 「只有它开的会话」; a damaged one is no grant at all (fail closed — a bad value never widens a key).
- **The key's row stays short however many grants it has (lane vault-key-row-compact — the owner 2026-10-21 05:4xZ: 「授权很多的时候，这个界面需要优化一下」; two grants already made the row a wall of text, twelve made it 818 px):** the row is a HEAD + folds. The head: the name · the kind chip · 「N 个动作」 · 「授权给 N 个」 · the last use (the key's own last call) · 显示 / 授权给… / 编辑… / 审计… / 撤销 — one line in a window ≥ 1180 px wide, the doors under the name in the default 980-px window, two lines on a phone (the name and its chips · the doors; the source chip shows its glyph). Under it the limits in ONE line of words — 「文件夹: 所有路径 · 账号: 任何 · 权限模式: 任何 · 模型: 任何 · 模式: 任何」: a set equal to everything the tables offer now says 任何 (PURE `limitSetView`; a one-row table is named), more than three picks say 「N 种」, the names in the title — never the full enumeration (PURE `limitsWords` and the CLI say «any» alike). 「N 个动作」 opens the verbs as a popover grouped by family (对话 / Agent 群组 / 反馈 — PURE `verbFamilies`) with 编辑… beside. 「授权给 N 个」 opens the grants IN PLACE (remembered per key for the page): one row per grant — a Task Group with its 岗位 glyph, a conversation with its state (运行中 / 已结束) — the reach chip (a click changes it) and ✕; Task Groups first, then running conversations, then ended ones, each by name (PURE `grantOrder`); about five rows show and the rest scroll inside the row (never a 显示更多); a filter box past eight. A grant to a conversation that is not running is ENDED (dim, 已结束 — the list names it by what the sidebar kept, else its id cut to 8 characters): it can never be used, and ONE door 「清理已结束的授权」 with their count beside it takes every such grant of the key back (POST …/keys/:id/prune-ended — one audit line `key.prune` naming what went; a conversation that comes back asks again on its next use).
- **A paint gap on an unattended desktop is not a freeze (lane incident-paint-gap, 2.369.339; inc-mvi50qdh-ygmh / inc-mvi5ggqh-1tz8 — the owner's Windows desktop filed two «jank storm» incidents it never felt):** the auto incident recorder treats a frame or compositor gap as jank only when the main thread was busy (a long task over half of it) or a person was there (a pointer/key during it or within 1 s after); an unattended window that simply stops painting — monitor off, lock screen, an occluded or GPU-asleep window (Chrome keeps `visibilityState` 'visible') — is a `paint-gap-s` metric and a ring line, shown in ⚙ Diagnostics, never an auto incident. The incident bundle's `screenEvents` now records `visibilitychange`, window `focus`/`blur`, Page-Lifecycle `freeze`/`resume` and the Idle Detection verdict (only when the page already holds the permission — never a new prompt). src/lib/telemetry-client.js `paintGapKind`; pinned by scripts/test-freeze-probe.mjs.
